notes.title: The First Descendant Patch 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!
 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Patch 1.3.5.

Descendants, please reconnect to the game for smoother gameplay.

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements

(1) Trigger Modules

- The performance of the following Trigger Modules has been improved.

Tactical Acceleration

- Adjusted the base cooldown time.

ㄴ 20s → 18s

- Adjusted the Tactical Acceleration cooldown time.

ㄴ 12s → 8s

Storm Bullet

- Improved so that Continuous Damage is affected by the Reactor's Attribute and Arche Power increase stats.

Blazing Zone

- Improved so that Continuous Damage is affected by the Reactor's Attribute and Arche Power increase stats.

 

(2) Miscellaneous

- Improved to ask for confirmation when overwriting Mutant Cells in Arche Tuning.

ㄴ Changed the "Overwrite Cell" button operation from "Hold" to "Press."

notes.title: 10/1(Wed) QoL Improvements Update Info
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

The October 1 (Wed) update will bring a variety of new content, including the addition of Sword weapons, along with several improvements aimed at enhancing overall gameplay convenience.

 

Here’s a preview of the major QoL improvements in this update, and we appreciate your continued support for the upcoming October update.

 

■ Major QoL Improvements

(1) Removal of Reactor Weapon Optimization Conditions

- To allow for more flexible use of different weapons and improve accessibility for new players, Optimization Conditions that were only applied when equipping specific weapons will be removed.

- Accordingly, the "Reactor Implant" function in the Auxiliary Workbench, related Quests, and Awards will also be removed.

- Additionally, with the removal of Optimization Conditions, the Skill Power increase that previously activated when meeting these conditions will be incorporated into the Reactor's base Skill Power. 

 

(2) Changes to Amorphous Material Opening Method

- To reduce the hassle of opening Amorphous Materials, this function will be improved to allow single or continuous opening through interaction with NPCs located in Albion.

- As a result, the Reconstructed Devices that were created when clearing Void Intercept Battles and Void Fusion Reactors will be removed.

- Additionally, please note that the Void Intercept Battle: Hard will be revised in the future and the current content format will be maintained until then.

 

(3) Laboratory Improvements

- The "Legion of Breach," a new legion introduced in Season 3 Axion Plains, will be added to the Laboratory Legion settings.

- The maximum number of Common Monsters that can be summoned in the Laboratory will be increased to 50.

 

We will continue to consider and implement improvements to enhance convenience and satisfaction for our Descendants.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Patch 1.3.4
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Patch 1.3.4.

Descendants, please reconnect to the game for smoother gameplay.

 

■ Patch Date

- 09.11.2025 (Thu) 00:00 PDT

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Patch Details

(1) UI & UX

- Improved sorting functionality for Weapons, Reactors, External Components, and Modules.

ㄴ Added several new items to the sorting list.

ㄴ Unified sorting criteria that were previously different for each item category to ensure all items are sorted using the same criteria.

- Improved the Axion Plains mission “AX Power Converter Station” so that the rate at which Defense Time decreases based on the number of protected objects is now visually displayed in the upper mission UI.

 

(2) Miscellaneous

- When viewing a Descendant's profile, made improvements to display "No information available." text if the target user has not unlocked Inversion Reinforcement.

 

Bug Fixes

(1) Content

- Fixed an issue in the Axion Plains mission “First Crater” where progression was blocked because the required monster kill count in certain sections was not registered correctly

- Arche Trace - In the "Replay Cutscenes" of the Luna-exclusive quest, Arche Traces will only be activate when Luna or Ultimate Luna are equipped.

ㄴ Albion - The Concert Begins!

ㄴ Kingston - A New Moon Rises

- Fixed an issue where Abyss Scarabs would move abnormally when damaged during their Regeneration animation.

- Fixed an intermittent issue where it was sometimes impossible to progress the quest “Let’s See Who Wins – Come up with taunting comments” during Luna’s exclusive questline.

 

(2) Descendants

Lepic

- Fixed an issue where the Grenade Throw Skill could be repeatedly used faster than normal when transitioning to other actions.

ㄴ This applies to all Grenade Throw Modification Modules.

ㆍ Nerve Infiltration and Explosive Stacks

Luna

- Fixed an issue where Notes would appear instantly and couldn't be hit with equipped Unique Weapons.

- Fixed an issue where Perfect Pitch effect wasn't being applied correctly.

- Fixed an issue where enhancement effects from Enhanced Skills weren't converting to Standard Skill effects.

- Fixed an issue where the Inspiration Gauge wasn't being correctly acquired when equipped with the "Nimble Footsteps" Module.

- Fixed the range indicator for "Fever Time!" in the Battlefield Concert.

ㄴ Changed from 3.5m to 7m forward

- Fixed the incorrect representation of Enhanced Skills in all Skill videos for Ultimate Luna's "Singer's Mercy" Module.

- Fixed the incorrect representation of the "Delightful Stage" Skill video when using Ultimate Luna's "Aggressive Melody" Module.

- Fixed an issue where the cooldown was applied when using Firearms and Skills simultaneously during "Fever Time!" while using Ultimate Luna's "Battlefield Concert" Module.

 

(3) Modules

- Fixed an issue where the Ultimate Tier Descendant Module's "Arche Concretion" effect was not reducing Firearm Explosive ATK.

- Fixed an issue where the Ultimate Tier Descendant Module “Walk a Tightrope” effect did not apply to Firearm Explosive ATK.

 

(4) UI & UX

- Fixed an issue where the "Non-Attribute" text was not displaying correctly in the Mission Details pop-up reward information.

- Fixed an issue where Matchmaking appeared to be canceled when the map changed immediately after applying for Void Erosion Purge: Normal Difficulty Stage 10 matching.

- Fixed an issue where attachment slots were visible in the Vehicle customization UI

- Fixed an issue where the PS Store icon overlapped with the Inbox button in the Shop.

 

(5) Miscellaneous

- Fixed an issue where discounts for owned items were not properly applied when purchasing the “Lounge Bundle.”

- Fixed an issue where Caliber was consumed when purchasing a Descendant while holding the “Descendant Purchase Ticket A, B, C.”

- Fixed an issue where purchasable Attendance Days were one day short of the maximum achievable days.

- Fixed an issue where the Tactical Mobility Teleporter at the Outpost in Vespers Moonlight Lake was floating.

- Fixed an issue where some item names were not displaying in the ETA Shop.

- Reset the purchase limit from 30 to 100 when buying Consumables, Gold, and Kuiper Shards with Quality Certified ETA Voucher.

- Modified Collectible Coins and Premium Collectible Coins to be included in the Library Consumables progress and to display their quantities in the Library.

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.3.3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!
 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.3.3.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Update 1.3.3

Lounge

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/49d607a53f2f6a80dfabb2c1caab6e1f5e49f212.png"]

- The Lounge is a place where Descendants can relax and take breaks between missions.

- You can enter the Lounge in Albion.

ㄴ You can enter the Lounge by carrying out the sub quest  that begins after the main quest  is completed.

- You can place Descendants, Fellows, Vehicles, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, and newly added Collectible items in the Lounge.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p align="center"]Categories
[/td][td][p align="center"]Text
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Descendants
[/td][td]
- You can place Descendants you own in the Lounge.

- If you own both the Normal and Ultimate versions of a Descendant, only the Ultimate Descendant can be placed.

- You can select a customization loadout to apply to Descendants placed in the Lounge.

- You can approach and chat with Descendants who are not assuming Lounge Poses.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Lounge Pose
[/td][td]
- Descendants placed in the Lounge will assume the Lounge Poses you own.

- You can select a Lounge Pose to assume from the Place Descendant screen, and lock a Lounge Pose to repeat.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Fellows
[/td][td]
- You can place Fellows you own in the Lounge.

- You can select a customization loadout to apply to Fellows placed in the Lounge.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Vehicle
[/td][td]
- You can place Vehicles you own in the Lounge.

- Vehicles placed in the Lounge will have their Customization settings applied.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Weapon Skins
[/td][td]
- You can place Weapon Skins for any weapon you've ever owned in the Lounge.

- Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge will have their Paint settings applied.

- Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Chest Attachments/Back Attachments
[/td][td]
- You can place Chest Attachments/Back Attachments you own in the Lounge.

- Chest Attachments/Back Attachments placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Lounge Collectibles (Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas)
[/td][td]
- You can place Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas you own in the Lounge.

- Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.

- You can rotate Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines to change their placement orientation.

- You can place Figurines on Dioramas.
[/td][/tr][/table]
- Random Placement

ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, your Descendants are randomly placed.

ㄴ When the Descendants are randomly placed, their loadouts are randomly selected and applied.

ㄴ Random Placement settings can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.

- Lounge Atmosphere

ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, lighting and weather are randomly applied.

ㄴ The Lounge atmosphere can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.

- Lounge Extension

ㄴ Upon reaching Mastery Rank 5, you can spend 1 million Gold to extend your Lounge by building a Bedroom.

ㄴ You can place additional Descendants, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, Ornaments, Trophies, and Figurines in the Bedroom.

ㄴ Some Lounge Poses can only be viewed through Descendants placed in the Bedroom.

- Lounge Photo Mode follows different rules from normal Photo Mode.

ㄴ Only free movement is allowed in Lounge Photo Mode.

ㄴ There is no Subject Tab in Lounge Photo Mode.

ㄴ You can save presets in Lounge Photo Mode separately from the presets saved in normal Photo Mode.

 

Collectibles

- Collectibles are items that can be placed in the Lounge for viewing.

ㄴ Ornaments: Collectibles that become increasingly detailed as they level up.

ㄴ Figurines: Collectibles that can be placed directly in the Lounge or on Dioramas.

ㄴ Trophies: Collectibles obtained by completing Awards.

ㄴ Dioramas: Sets that serve as backdrops for placing Figurines.

ㄴ Lounge Poses: Actions that Descendants placed in the Lounge can perform.

- Ornaments and Figurines can be obtained by purchasing Common or Premium Collectibles Boxes via the "Purchase Collectibles" feature from Collec-T in Albion or Edi-T in the Lounge.

ㄴ One Common Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Collectible Coins, and one Premium Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Premium Collectible Coins.

(4) Battle Pass

- The following Battle Pass Daily achievements have been rebalanced:

ㄴ Reduced the number of monster defeats with specific weapons for Assignments.

ㄴ Reduced the number of monster defeats with specific Attributes and Arche Skills for Assignments.

ㄴ Reduced the number of Commander defeats for Assignments.

ㄴ Modified the Outpost Clear objective so it no longer appears for all players.

ㄴ Modified the Acquire Amorphous Materials objective so it no longer appears for Expert players.

ㄴ Modified the Rescue your squad Assignment so that only the XP 10,000 task appears.

ㄴ Modified the Open Encrypted Vault Assignment so that only the XP 10,000 task appears.

ㄴ Modified the Infiltration Clear Assignment so that only XP 10,000 task appears for expert players.

 

(5) Vehicles

- Colliding into monsters while mounting a Vehicle pushes the monster back with Knockback and deals a small amount of damage.

ㄴ Colliding into a monster slightly reduces the Vehicle's Speed.

ㄴ The monster knockback distance depends on the Vehicle's Speed.

- Modified to allow the players to use unique weapons while on a Vehicle.

ㄴ Using a unique weapon will make the player dismount the vehicle and equip the selected unique weapon.

- Modified to allow the players to mount a Vehicle while using a unique weapon.

ㄴ Pressing the Mount key now unequips the Unique Weapon before mounting.

 

(6) UI & UX

- Improvements were made to play different acquisition animation by item acquisition history.

ㄴ A mini animation will be played (e.g., displaying the item name only) for re-acquiring items that were previously acquired.

ㄴ A big animation will be played along with the item's icon for newly acquired items or important items.

ㆍ A big animation will be played for Tracking On or Target Reward items.

ㄴ Slightly reduced the duration of the item acquisition animation.

- Added the display of social tags set by logged-in Descendants in social pop-up.

ㄴ If offline, it will be empty.

ㄴ Social tags can be set in Party > My Tags.

- Added Search function to Weapons, Reactors, and External Components Inventory.

ㄴ You can enter keywords such as names, types, options, etc., to search for items you want.

ㄴ The key-shaped keyword search button allows a faster keyword selection.

- Added Detailed Filter function to Weapons, Reactors, and External Components Inventory.

ㄴ Select Detailed Filter button to set multiple conditions for filtered search.

ㄴ You can pick and choose various conditions, such as level, tier, type, option, etc., to look for the item you want.

- Improvements were made to Quest Path Display Drones to not overlap with NPCs.

 

(7) Dimensional Breach Alert

- Modified the Contribution calculation standards.

ㄴ Contribution is accumulated according to the ratio of damage dealt to Wall Crasher at the time of its defeat.

ㄴ The highest contribution will be accumulated in the same round of battle against Wall Crasher.

ㄴ Only the highest contribution will be reflected in the final result, no matter how many times you play the same round. The rest will be discarded.

- Added Help guide to Dimensional Breach Alert pop-up.

 

(8) Miscellaneous

- Improvements were made to remove some Skills remaining in the Battle area once the monster is killed.

- Improvements were made to display the matchmaking stage first when you enter the screen during Void Erosion Purge matchmaking.

- Added 2 new types of Social Tags in Party tap.

notes.title: Apology and Compensation Announcement for Issues After Season 3 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Descendants. This is The First Descendant Producer Beom-jun Lee.
 

I would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced due to the recurring issues during the recent Season 3 update. Through today’s announcement, I would like to address the issues related to the "Battle Pass" and "Wall Crasher" content.

 

First, regarding the "Battle Pass," there were continuous errors such as Weekly Challenges not refreshing and abnormal Daily Challenge EXP gains, which directly affected our Descendants' achievements and rewards. This issue arose during our response to Battle Pass errors after the 1.3.1 patch, and it was caused by inadequate handling by the Dev Team and an insufficient QA process. As the person in charge, I would like to apologize once again. We would like to assure you that we are continuously working to resolve the remaining issues.

 

Next, regarding the highly anticipated "Wall Crasher," we identified issues with reward drops at the beginning of the season, as well as unintended gameplay that exploited the party play function. We are currently preparing improvements for these issues.

 

We also humbly accept the feedback that Season 3 content as a whole has not met expectations in terms of stability and completeness. The Dev Team will do their utmost to address the remaining issues with urgency while ensuring the previously announced monthly update plans continue without delay.

 

In addition, the Dev Team aims to pursue more fundamental and sustainable improvements by learning from the issues that have emerged this season.

 

Above all, we plan to establish a more stable development environment by reorganizing inefficient internal processes that have accumulated since launch.

 

Not only will we make short-term efforts to prevent issues through more thorough inspections, but also, in the mid- to long-term, plan to comprehensively review and address problems within our inefficient development processes that have accumulated over time.

 

Through these efforts, we will do our best to develop faster and more stable response capabilities to provide updates that will better satisfy our Descendants.

 

While it may not fully make up for the disappointment our Descendants have felt regarding these issues, we have prepared the following compensation as a token of our sincerest apologies.

 

■ Compensation

- Rewards will be delivered to your mailbox within approximately 10 minutes of logging in on the distribution date specified below.

ㄴ The Battle Pass EXP compensation will not be delivered through the Mailbox but will be automatically applied upon login. If it is not correctly applied, please try logging in again.

- The Mail Expiration Date is 09.10.2025 (Wed) 23:59 PDT. Please make sure to claim your rewards before expiration.

(3) Target Reward

- Registration of Target Reward unit has been changed from by acquisition source to item.

- When an item is registered as Target Reward, you can accumulate Target Reward Progress in any content that offers the item as a reward.

ㄴ Example

ㆍ Previous: Register "Item A / Void Vessel" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing Void Vessel

ㆍ Changed: Register "Item A" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing any content (e.g., Void Vessel, Intercept Battle, Missions, etc.) that offers the item as a reward

- Target Reward Progress accumulates by 1/n by the number of effective Target Rewards when playing a content.

ㄴ Example

ㆍ If the progress gauge for A and B are 50 and 30, respectively, in a content

ㆍ Previous: Get 50 for A and / 30 for B

ㆍ Changed: Get 25 for A and / 15 for B

 

(4) UI & UX

- Improved the purchase description that is displayed for the selected Descendant or Weapon upon purchasing a Loadout Slot.

ㄴ Previous: Purchases cannot be cancelled once the transaction has been completed.

ㄴ Changed: Expands only the Loadout Slots for the selected \[Descendant] or \[Weapon]. Purchases cannot be cancelled once the transaction has been completed.

- Added filters to search for Weapon Type that meets the Optimization Condition in Reactor Implant Menu.

- Improvements were made to play the BGM while previewing Emotes that have BGM in the Shop or Customize Menu.

ㄴ Changes apply to the following four Emotes.

ㆍ Congas

ㆍ Comic Dance

ㆍ Feel the Rhythm

ㆍ Fantastic Performance

- The Modules section in the Library has been divided into more specific categories.

ㄴ It is now broadly divided into Firearms and Descendants, with additional subcategories added.

ㆍ Firearms - Categorized by Round

ㆍ Descendants - Categorized by Common, Skill/Sub, or Trigger

- Added "Preview in Field" function for Customize - Paint Weapon Skins.

- Added the display image that appears when you attempt to open the map in areas that maps are not available.

 

(5) Sound

- Improved in-game SFX as shown below:

ㄴ Improved gun sounds to add unique shooting experience to each gun.

ㄴ Improved shooting experiences by adding Weak Point Shooting Sound for Colossi.

ㄴ Improved shooting experience by adding Immunity Shooting Sound in Immune situations.

ㄴ Changed the item acquisition sound.

ㆍ Renewed the item acquisition sound to ease the player's auditory fatigue from hearing the same sound repeatedly.

ㄴ Further categorized sound setting items.

ㆍ More detailed options available for the players to adjust SFX, UI, Voice volume, etc., to suit their playstyles.

ㄴ Improved recognition by adding Monster voices for each battle situtation.

ㄴ Improved the sound balance to make Melee Attack sounds more audible.

ㄴ Character-specific interaction dialogues will now be played.

ㆍ Dialogues that show individual character's personality will be played for DBNO interactions.

- Improved in-game music as shown below:

ㄴ Added exclusive music for each Mission in Battlefield.

ㆍ Exclusive Mission music will be played for Basic Missions, Battlefield Missions, and Collection Missions for better immersion.

ㆍ Exclusive music will play during the "Mobile Energy Monitoring" mission in the Axion Plains.

ㄴ Improved Colossus Battles Sounds (including Void Intercept Battles)

ㆍ Each Colossus will have unique music playing.

ㆍ Increased the player immersion by enhancing music that is played at the commencement of Interception and killing of a Colossus.

ㆍ Exclusive notification sound is played when a Colossus is killed to clarify the battle progress.

ㄴ Renewed the Void Erosion Purge music.

ㆍ Added different variants of songs that are easier on ears and played randomly to reduce the players' fatigue in item farming.

ㄴ Improved exclusive music for Descendants.

ㆍ All Descendants music resource has been remastered for quality enhancement.

ㆍ Descendant theme songs are played in loop for enhanced recognition.

ㆍ Improved immersion by having character battle music play only during combat with monsters.

ㄴ All music tracks for Infiltration Operations have been remastered to improve sound quality.

ㄴ Albion's exclusive music has been remastered to improve sound quality.

ㄴ Added music to Laboratory.

 

(6) Other

- Pool decorations in Albion have been removed.

- A “Set Primary Account” feature has been added to the in-game menu.
ㄴ You can access it via ESC > Account > Manage Account Info > Primary Account Setup.
ㄴ If you have linked your account but haven't designated a primary account yet, you can set it upon logging in to the game and start playing.
ㄴ Changing the primary account setting will return you to the title screen.
ㄴ If you set your primary account on the web while the game is running, you must reconnect to the game for the change to take effect.

- Changed the Weapon Core Unlocking condition to reaching Mastery Rank 15.

- Improved to allow Descendant replacement outside the Outpost and Temporary Safe Zone.

ㄴ Replacement is not possible while a Mission is in progress.

ㄴ You can obtain rewards by participating in the Season 3 survey and submitting your responses through the pop-up that appears after clicking the button.

ㄴ For detailed information about Season 3 Survey period/method/rewards, please refer to the event notice. \[Go to Event Notice]

- Changed the name of "Spoils Box" which can be acquired from Sigma Sector to "Mutant Cell Box."

- An Nvidia DLSS Transformer Model (Preset K) option has been added to Graphics Settings.

# Director's Comments

This balance improvement focuses on reviewing the way Descendant skills apply movement speed changes, adjusting the values of some of the less used Descendants, and easing the gap between Firearm Descendants and Serena.

 

As mentioned during yesterday’s Descendant Fest 2025, we will continue to address balance gaps between Descendants through monthly balance patches in Season 3.

As a first step, we'll be making improvements to Jayber's skills on August 7th.

We're also reviewing the combat efficiency of Skill Descendants in higher-difficulty content like the Axion Plains and are currently tuning balance with Ines as the benchmark.

 

The Dev Team is aware of the current disparity between Firearm Descendants and Skill Descendants. We aim to reduce this gap using Serena as the reference point for Firearm Descendants, and Ines for Skill Descendants.

We will continue to take gradual steps to bridge the gap between Skill and Firearm Descendants through our ongoing monthly balance updates.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.21
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.21, patched maintenance-free.

 

■ Patch Date

- 06.26.2025 (Thu) 00:00 PDT

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5

 

■ Patch Details

(1) Content Improvements

- The placement of the buttons (Select All, Apply, Close) at the bottom in the Descendant selection popup in the Store has been modified for better usability.

- The Shop has been improved to allow purchasing multiple "Attendance Mementos" at once.

- Changed the spray images for "Spring Breeze," "First Snow," and "Artist's Precious Belongings".

 

(2) Bug Fixes

- Updated certain Sub Quest markers from NPCs "Deslin" and "Weapon Workbench" to now display at the "Auxiliary Workbench" and "Core Crafting Bench" NPCs.

- Fixed an issue where the colors of Arche Tuning levels were displaying incorrectly in the HUD.

- Fixed an issue where Sharen and Jayber's metallic jaw cosmetic would appear in the lobby UI regardless of the Descendants unique cosmetics settings when the active customization loadout slot was not slot 1.

- Fixed an issue where after dying with no Rounds left upon reviving the weapon HUD would display Rounds incorrectly.

- Fixed an issue where the shop would appear empty when the "View Only Available Items" option was enabled.

- Fixed an issue where enhancing External Component Cores would complete the "Complete Weapon Core Utilization Training" quest.

- Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally stutter when simultaneously pressing the left and right mouse buttons while adjusting stickers in Photo Mode.

 

Thank you.

Additional External Component Cores

- "External Component Cores" that enhance the performances of External Components have been added.

- External Components of "Ultimate" Tier or higher have theirs Core unlocked and do not require Core Unlocking.

- You may equip External Component Cores by using Albion's "Core Crafting Bench" once reaching Mastery Rank 8.

- Crafting and conversion of existing Cores are not available at "Core Crafting Bench" once you reach Mastery Rank 8.

- All External Components have two Core Slots and each of them have assigned Augment Types.

ㄴ When an External Component Core is equipped, a random option is granted per the Augment type.

- External Component Core items have stages, marked with Roman numerals (e.g., I, II, III, etc.). The higher the stage, the better the option effect values they provide.

ㄴ Each option has a fixed value range based on the External Component Core item's stage, and the final value is randomly determined within that range.

- An External Component Core that is equipped to a Core Slot may be replaced with another one.

ㄴ To change an External Component Core, a "Core Particle Disruptor" item is required, just as for a Weapon Core.

ㄴ When replacing an External Component Core, you may choose from the existing effects and the new effects. If you do not like the new effects, choose to keep the existing one.

ㄴ If you decide to keep the existing effects, the External Component Core and Core Particle Disruptor spent for the replacement are not returned.

- You may craft External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.

ㄴ To craft an External Component Core, a "Core Amplifier" is needed, just as for a Weapon Core.

- You may convert External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.

ㄴ You may convert Stage 10 External Component Cores, just as for Weapon Cores.

- External Component Core items can be acquired from the "400% Infiltration Operation" and "Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation."

ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation Normal Stage 1-8

ㄴ Infiltration Operation: Hard 400% Stage 2-10

ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation High-risk Stage 3-10

- You can choose to equip or replace the existing "Hit Augmentation Core" or the new "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" to the Hit Augmentation Slot.

ㄴ You can replace an existing Core equipped to a slot with a "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)," and vice versa.

notes.title: Content Availability Adjustment Due to Season 3 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants.

 

Due to the rescheduling of the Season 3 update to Thursday, August 7, the availability periods of content originally set to reset or end with the next season will also be adjusted accordingly.

 

Please refer to the details below regarding the content with updated availability periods:

 

■ Battle Pass

- The duration of the Season 2 Episode 2 – “Beyond the Void” Battle Pass will be extended to Thursday, August 7.

- The Bonus Shop will remain accessible until the Season 3 update, and daily challenges will continue to be available.

ㄴ However, please note that no new weekly challenges will be added beyond Week 14.

 

■ Inversion Reinforcement

- The reset schedule for Inversion Reinforcement from Season 2 Episode 2 has been extended to Thursday, August 7.

- As a result, the Collect Ironheart Particles missions for each region will also remain available until the Season 3 update

 

■ Leaderboard

- The reward distribution schedule for the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge leaderboard will also be moved to Thursday, August 7, in line with the extended season duration.

ㄴ However, due to an issue that could affect leaderboard rankings, the leaderboard will be reset during the June 19 (Thu) update as part of the bug fix.

ㄴ Rankings will be based on new records accumulated after the fix on June 19, so we kindly ask for your understanding.

 

■ Void Erosion Purge: Challenge

- The reset schedule for Void Erosion Purge: Challenge corruption purge stages will be extended to Thursday, August 7.

- Accordingly, the reset timing for stage-specific clear rewards will also be adjusted.

 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the adjustments to content availability due to the update schedule.

As a token of our apology, we have prepared the following compensation:

notes.title: 2025 Skin Contest Submission Extension & Award Criteria Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants! 

The submission period for the 2025 Skin Contest, which began on May 12 (Mon), has been extended to allow for greater participation and creativity.
We hope this change will give all Descendants more time to finalize and submit their designs.

In addition, the award criteria for Descendant skins have been updated.
Instead of selecting finalists by gender categories (Men / Women / Unisex), all Descendant skin entries will now be reviewed under a unified selection format.
This update aims to reduce the burden on participants and encourage a wider range of creative submissions.

Please note that we have identified several entries that do not follow the official submission guidelines.
To be considered, entries must be submitted using the official template. Submissions consisting solely of screenshots or standalone illustrations without the template will not be eligible for finalist selection.

Please refer to the details below for full information on the schedule changes and award updates.

■ Updated Event Schedule

- If the number of submissions or qualified entries is limited, the number of finalists and winners may vary by category (Descendant / Fellow).
- If no entries meet the minimum finalist criteria in a specific category, no finalists may be selected for that category.

■ Submission Guidelines
- Please download the appropriate template based on the skin category you are entering and follow the instructions. [Guidelines] [Download Template]
- Submissions that include only screenshots or standalone images without the template will not be considered for finalist selection.

We look forward to your creative participation in the 2025 Skin Contest.

Thank you.

# PDT 2025.05.29(THU) 00:00 – Update 1.2.18 >View Descendant: Additional information has been added.  # PDT 2025.05.25 (SUN) 08:00 – Weapon & Module > Bug Fixes: The content regarding the issue of stackable skills not being reset has been revised.  # PDT 2025.05.22 (WED) 01:00 – Update > Arche Tuning Reset Details Modified  # PDT 2025.05.21(WED) 23:00 – The content regarding the PS platform sound output bug fix and the UI&UX option items have been added to the bug fixes.  # PDT 2025.05.21(WED) 22:50 – The content regarding the Dynamic Motion Level has been added.     Greetings, Descendants!      Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.18.     ■ Platforms  - Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5     ■ Update 1.2.18     (Added) Dynamic Motion 

(Added) Dynamic Motion has been added.

ㄴ Dynamic Motion Level has been added. It consists of Weak / Medium / Strong, and the default setting is Medium.  ㄴ Check it in Options > Gameplay > Display Settings.     Arche Tuning  [img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250522/bb636ed1-f45f-47d2-8e37-25868d38556d/1%EC%95%84%EB%A5%B4%EC%BC%80%EC%A1%B0%EC%9C%A8.jpg"] - A new Node is added to Arche Tuning, and "Mutant Cell Slot" is also added.  ㄴ After the 1.2.18 update, all Arche Tuning settings and presets will be reset, excluding the Unique Arche Factor Level and the number of Arche Tunings. Arche Tuning must be reconfigured.  ㄴ After the 1.2.18 update, the following will not be reset: Arche Unique Factor Level, number of Arche Tuning slots owned, Arche Tuning settings, and presets.  - The "Reset" button of the Node has been changed so that you can use Mutant Cell Slot function.

- "Mutant Cell" can be equipped in the Mutant Cell Slot to apply additional effects.  ㄴ Mutant Cell Slot can be activated the same as Normal Node. Activating it does not consume Arche Tuning.  - After activating Mutant Cell Slot, it must be "unlocked" to equip Mutant Cell.  - Each Mutant Cell Slot requires to be unlocked once, and the result will be applied to all loadouts to the unlocked Descendant Group.  ㄴ Unlocking requires 100 Fission Accelerants.  ㄴ Fission Accelerants can be acquired by defeating the commander in Sigma Sector Normal/High-risk Difficulty.  - Equip state of Mutant Cell is not shared among loadouts.  ㄴ For example, Mutant Cell equipped to loadout 1 is saved exclusively in loadout 1, and not equipped to loadout 2 or 3.  - Mutant Cell Slots have Socket Types. Each slot has designated Socket Type that requires Mutant Cells that have the same Socket Types.  ㄴ To change the effect of the equipped Mutant Cell, you must override it with another Mutant Cell.  ㄴ When overrode with another Mutant Cell, the equipped Mutant Cell will perish.  ㄴ Overriding Mutant Cell does not incur any cost.  - Use "Extract" function to retrieve an equipped Mutant Cell.  ㄴ Extraction requires 100 ARC Genetic Scissors.  ㆍ ARC Genetic Scissors can be acquired by defeating the commander in Sigma Sector Normal/High-risk Difficulty.  ㄴ Extracted Mutant Cells are sent to Mutant Cell Inventory and can be equipped in other Mutant Cell Slots.  - When resetting Mutant Cell Slots or all Arche Tuning, the reset will be applied while the equipped Mutant Cells stay as they were.  ㄴ Even if you have a Mutant Cell equipped, if the Mutant Cell Slot itself has been reset, effects will not be applied.  - Mutant Cells can be acquired by opening Spoils Box and selecting the Mutant Cell you wish to acquire.  ㄴ Acquired Mutant Cells can be found in the Mutant Cell Inventory in Arche Tuning Board.  - Spoils Box can be acquired from Sigma Sector Mission completion rewards.  ㄴ Completing High-risk Sigma Sector Mission: 5%  ㄴ Completing Normal Difficulty Sigma Sector Mission: 2.5%  ㄴ Other than Sigma Sector, it can also be acquired by defeating the commander in 400% Infiltration Operation with a low chance.  - A new item "Mutant Cell" has been added.

# Director's Comments

The newly adopted Arche Tuning "Mutant Cell" is designed to enhance the battle efficiency of Skill Dealer Descendants.

However, we do recognize that there is still a performance gap to Firearm Dealers. 
We plan to bridge this gap in a careful and gradual manner, rather than hastily rushing to eliminate it.

"Mutant Cell" is our first step in doing so. We will continue to add more ways to bring the performance difference closer. 
Once the performance gap among Skill dealers has been filled to some extend, we will be adding more Mutant Cells with a wide range effects to diversify gameplay styles.

Also, we are planning an External Components Core Update scheduled for June 19, and it will support the growth of defensive ability of all Descendants.
In addition, it will offer new opportunities for you to set Skill dealer Descendants in more aggressive ways.

We will continue to keep a good balance of the game by encouraging each Descendant to exploit their unique battle styles and advantages.
[/td][/tr][/table]

			 # Director’s Comments 			 To improve gameplay styles of Void Abyss Intercept Battle that ends in under 1 second and reward structure that requires excessive repetitions, we implemented the following changes: 			 First, the play time was adjusted in consideration of the extremely short battle duration that prevented strategic gameplays. 			With this adjustment, we aimed to bring out the necessity to employ attribute-based battle strategies. 			Ice Maiden, especially, was designed to have a structure that shortens the clear time as players destroy its parts and gradually enhance the Descendant’s Skill Power. 			 Next, we heard your opinion of the low multi-player battle efficiency and adjusted the HP and Shield multipliers that was applied to 4-player rounds from 3.2 times to 2 times. 			With this adjustment, we expect our players to enjoy faster and more meaningful gameplay experiences in multi-player modes. 			 As the battle duration will increase, we also adjusted the reward efficiency. 			Rewards have been adjusted to require less attempts to be acquired to ease the burden of repetitive plays, and we made adjustments to offer more customizable items. 			However, to ensure the existing growth-oriented rewards, you will be able to exchange some of the growth rewards with Quality Certified ETA Voucher. 			 We will continue to make detailed adjustments to Intercept Battles so that you can enjoy tactical gameplays and the joy of defeating formidable enemies with other players. 			
[/td][/tr][/table]

			 # Director’s Comments 			 Thank you for giving us lots of feedback on potential additions to Multi-Hit Core. 			 We decided on this development based on feedback from players. 			We listened to various opinions on how we should implement the Multi-Hit Chance and Damage stats into the Cores. 			The most popular suggestion was to add them to Special Augmentation, followed by suggestions to put them in Hit Augmentation. 			 We felt it would be more appropriate to include them in the family of Hit Augmentations so that Multi-Hit could become a competitive option alongside Critical Hit. 			However, we also had to consider that increasing the number of Hit Augmentation Core stats to five would make it harder to get the desired stats. 			 Accordingly, we opted to keep the existing Cores unchanged and added a new Hit Augmentation AB Core instead. 			This Core can be equipped in the Hit Augmentation slot, and consists of three stats: Multi-Hit Chance, Multi-Hit Damage, and Weak Point Damage. notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.15
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants! 
 
Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.15, patched maintenance-free.
 
■ Patch Date
- 04.24.2025 (Thu) 02:00 PDT
 
■ Platforms
- Nexon, Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5
 
■ Patch Details
 
Content Improvements 
(1) Content Improvements
- Added an item to the "Arche Trace" to allow players to rewatch cinematics after completing Blair's Exclusive Story. 
ㄴ These cinematics can be rewatched at the "Arche Trace" in Albion. 
- Removed the required Mastery Rank conditions that were needed to research certain Ultimate Weapons with Anais. 
 
(2) Descendants 
- Improved ground-based persistent effects created during certain Descendants movements to also generate while the Descendant moves in midair using Jumps or Grappling Hooks.
ㄴ Viessa: Frost Road (Including Skill Module)
ㄴ Valby: Clean Up
ㄴ Freyna: Venom Synthesis (Skill Module)
 
(3) Miscellaneous
- Added guidance text showing where to check items after purchase from the Shop in the purchase popup notification for products under the following subcategories. 
ㄴ Descendant Bundles, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, and Spawns
- Added a "Skill Cooldown" display option within the Skill icons on the HUD in Options > Gameplay Settings.
 
 
Bug Fixes
(1) Content 
- Fixed an issue where the Commander monster's HP was displayed as 0 in the information UI screen until it spawned when summoned through the Rally Point passage.
- Fixed an issue where effects and sounds were repeatedly playing when Serena stood on the Commander Monster combat space tile during the Legion of Darkness Invasion Operation.
 
(2) Descendants 
- Fixed an issue where the Descendant Serena was not consuming resources when using the "Ascension" Skill immediately upon entering the field.
- Fixed an issue where dismissing "Ultimate Blair" provided 200,000 Gold as compensation instead of 500,000 Gold. 
ㄴ For players who dismissed "Ultimate Blair" after the 4/17 (Thu) update patch and before the hotfix 1.2.15 patch, Gold will be distributed sequentially via mail after 04.24.2025 (Thu) 22:00 PDT. 
- Fixed an issue where items would occasionally not drop when using the "Deadly Feast" Skill with the "Killer Recipe" Module equipped on Ultimate Blair.
 
(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed an issue where hit sounds were not playing when using the Hot Delivery skill after equipping Blair's "Next-level Recipe" Modification Module.
- Fixed an issue where targets could be hit beyond the maximum range of weapons.
- Fixed an issue where the 'Lethal Infection' module was applying 'skill power boost ratio' instead of 'skill power modifier'.

(4) UI & UX
- Fixed an issue where the icons for "Ultimate Blair's" Enhanced Cells, Stabilizer, and Spiral Catalyst were being displayed as Research Materials Blueprint icons.
- Fixed an issue where purchase popup messages for Paints in the Shop were displaying in English when Korean was the selected language. 
- Fixed an issue where the Stage selection UI would disappear when pressing the A or D shortcut keys in the Void Erosion Purge Challenge Difficulty.
- Fixed an issue where the button in the tooltip for Amorphous Materials was not functioning in the Special Operations reward screen.
- Fixed an issue where items in the ETA-0 Shop were shown as purchasable but could not actually be purchased.
- Fixed an issue where the game would close when clicking the "Cancel" button while switching tabs in the Recommended section of the Shop.
 
Thank you.

Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.14.

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Update 1.2.14

New Descendant: Ultimate Blair
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/df50c4f26cddc03edb88c7788277555c981befe3.jpg
- Added a new Ultimate Descendant, Ultimate Blair.
ㄴ You can acquire blueprints and codes from Amorphous Materials.
ㄴ You can acquire materials needed for research in Sigma Sector.
- Equipping Blair or Ultimate Blair will activate the Descendant Exclusive Quest for Blair.
- Completing Blair's exclusive quest rewards you with the chest attachment Pyromaniac Objet.
Skill Modules
- Skill Module 1: Killer Recipe 
ㄴ Attacking an enemy inflicted with Burn increases your Critical Hit Rate, Critical Hit Damage, and Skill Power to deal damage. Attacking an enemy inflicted with Burn generates Chef's Touch.
ㄴ Fires a meatball forward that explodes on impact, dealing damage and inflicting Burn on enemies.
ㄴ Designates an enemy in front and fires Chef's Touch. It flies in pursuit of the designated enemy and deals damage.
- Skill Module 2: Next-level Recipe
ㄴ Creates a Flame Zone under your feet at certain intervals. Enemies that step on a Flame Zone take damage and are inflicted with Burn.
ㄴ Spurts fire forward. Fire has up to 3 levels, and changes in level when Skill Effect Range reaches a certain value.
ㄴ You can acquire Ultimate Blair's skill modules from Hard Intercept Battles and Module Combine.
Added Ultimate Blair Amorphous Materials
- Amorphous Material Patterns 013, 029, 036, 042, 056, 075, 082, 093-Variant AC, 105, 106, 113-Variant AA, and 115-Variant AA can no longer be acquired.
ㄴ You can continue using the Amorphous Materials you already have as before.
- Added the "AC variants" of Amorphous Material Patterns 013, 029, 036, 042, 056, 075, 082, 093, 105, 106, 113, and 115.
ㄴ You can acquire Ultimate Blair's Enhanced Cell Blueprint, Stabilizer Blueprint, Spiral Catalyst Blueprint, and Code from these Amorphous Materials.

Added Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Difficulty
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/2ccade61a3afc154abb09df9e1c9afd814e94925.png
Unlock Requirements
- Unlocks upon clearing Void Erosion Purge: Normal Difficulty .
How to Access
- You can access it via the Infiltration Operations Terminal or the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge icon on the World Map.
How to Play
- Void Erosion Purge: Challenge consists of 5 stages.
- Players start at stage 1 and the rest of the stages are locked.
- After starting Erosion Purge, you'll need to defeat the Vulgus Legion to fill the target gauge. When the gauge is full, the final Commander will appear. Defeat the Commander to complete the Void Erosion Purge.
- Complete Erosion Purge within the target time to unlock the next stage.
Determination of Outcome
- Erosion Purge Complete: If you complete the mission within the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards and unlock the next stage.
- Mission Complete: If you complete the mission but exceed the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards but the next stage won't be unlocked.
- Mission Failed: If you fail to complete the mission and exceed all 15 minutes of playtime, you will not receive the mission completion rewards and the next stage won't be unlocked.
Rewards
- Only Rounds, MP and HP items drop from the Vulgus Legion that appear, and you cannot obtain other items, Descendant EXP or Firearm Proficiency from defeating them.
- Tier X Cores and Weapon Core Amplifiers are available as one-time rewards the first time you complete the Erosion Purge mission.
Public Operation Availability
- Only "Start Private Operation" is available for all stages 1/2/3/4/5.
Season Reset
The cleared Erosion Purge stages are reset every season episode, allowing you to acquire the First Completion Reward again after the reset.
※ With the addition of the Challenge difficulty, the existing Void Erosion Purge has been renamed to Void Erosion Purge: Normal.

Added Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Difficulty Leaderboard
- Added the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Leaderboard.
- You can check it on the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Start screen and the Results screen.
- The Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Leaderboard ranks players by their highest stage clear time.
- The Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Leaderboard will be reset as follows:
ㄴ Reset start time: After the server maintenance on 2025.04.16 (Wed) 
ㄴ Reset cycle: Season episode

External Components
- Added new External Components.

# Director's Comments
Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.

The balance between Descendants has been an important topic of discussion in the community.
Recently, successive releases of new overpowered Descendants such as Ines and Serena have caused some content being cleared way more easily than intended. We're taking this trend seriously, and this rebalance is our first step toward addressing the problem.
 
This rebalance focused on strengthening relatively underperforming Descendants, using as basis the performance of Viessa, Valby, and Hailey, who are the current baseline. However, we recognize that for some Descendants, simply tweaking some numbers are not enough to bring out the best in them. We believe that the mechanics of certain skills may need to be reworked to achieve more meaningful performance improvements, but we had to adjust multiple Descendants simultaneously and we apologize for focusing on numerical balancing this time. We understand that you may find some changes inadequate because of that, but we'll continue to review and implement improvements to skill structure and design.

Conversely, we determined that some of the Descendants whose performance significantly exceeded the baseline and could impact content structure needed adjustments. Ines is a prime example of this and her performance is significantly above the baseline, so we made some adjustments in this patch. Freyna's performance is also above the baseline, but not so much that it breaks the flow of the content, so we've put the adjustments on hold. Serena is a firearm-based dealer who we believe is currently significantly exceeding the baseline, but since she hasn't been released for long, we'd like to see more data before deciding on how to respond.
 
We don't believe we can balance all the Descendants perfectly with this single patch. We'll continue to closely analyze post-patch data and make further adjustments to Descendants that fall short of the baseline or are overperforming based on community feedback. We'll also finetune Serena's performance along the way.
 
We're also keenly aware that we've been releasing new Descendants in an overpowered state. While the Dev Team does hope for the new Descendants to be in the spotlight, we don't want them to be released overpowered to the point of breaking down the content structure. We're looking internally at the reasons for this recurring issue, and we're working to improve our development process so that we can deliver more stable and balanced content in the future.
 
We're deeply grateful to all the players for their continued heartfelt feedback on The First Descendant. We consider this rebalance a step towards further refining the balance, and we'll continue to make adjustments and improvements based on play data, and do our best to provide a better gaming experience.
 
Additionally, in response to community feedback, we are currently working on improving Serena's wings so that they are no longer visible when she equips a common skin. The wings will only be displayed when she uses her skills, and this change will be implemented in the April 17 patch.


Thank you.

- In Arche Tuning, the Rare 'Skill Power Modifier' Enhancement Node has been changed to Rare 'Skill Power' Enhancement Node.
ㄴ Rare Skill Power Modifier 10% → Rare Skill Power +500.582 
ㄴ When certain modules caused 'Skill Power Modifier' values to be negative, the calculation method led to excessive amplification, 
causing inconveniences when grinding. It has been replaced with 'Skill Power' for better usability.

(2) UI & UX

Bug Fixes
(1) Content

(2) Descendants

- Fixed an issue where the pop-up message displayed "Infiltration Operation" when attempting to enter "Sigma Sector" as a party member.
- Modified the description of the Event Challenge "Assist with Serena's Covert Operations." 
ㄴ Removed unnecessary punctuation marks in Korean description.

(6) Miscellaneous

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.10
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.10.
You can also check out the update details on Season 2: Beyond the Void page! [Link]


■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Update 1.2.10

Main Quest: Sigma Sector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/2e5e2245dcb2308c9d6d3b725cc33b3c8e871a72.jpg

- Added the  main quest, which takes place after the Descendant Corps destroyed the first Ironheart.
ㄴ The  main quest is available after completing the  zone main quest.
ㄴ During the , completing the  allows you to check the  in a record.
ㄴ If you investigate all traces of the Early Descendants listed in this record, you will receive a special Chest Attachment.

New Content: Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation
- Sigma Sector has been restricted for a century due to the strong Void Erosion phenomena there. In a land where nothing was thought to survive, now traces of the enemy have been found.  
Penetrate the powerful Void Storm and find out what's going on in Sigma Sector.
- Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation becomes available after completing the main quest 'Responsibility, Regret, and Atonement.'
- The features of Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation are as follows:
ㄴ A new field, Sigma Sector, is added.
ㄴ Sigma Sector features a new type of monsters from the Legion of Immortality, the Defects. 
ㄴ Sigma Sector consists of two zones, Broken Boundary and Isolated Desert, with two difficulty levels, Normal and High-risk, based on the Storm Level.
ㄴ One of the four missions for each zone and difficulty level is randomly selected and carried out.
ㄴ Reaching Mastery Rank 15 and completing an Isolated Desert mission unlocks Broken Boundary on High-risk Difficulty.
ㄴ Completing a Broken Boundary mission on High-risk Difficulty unlocks Isolated Desert on High-risk Difficulty.
ㄴ Defeating certain monsters in Sigma Sector will drop Sigma Sector exclusive unique weapons, Ground Custodian.
ㄴ When you acquire a Ground Sweeper, you can deal more damage to enemies or destroy the enemy's giant transport ships more effectively. 
- During the Sigma Sector main quest, you can earn the following rewards that will help your Descendant:
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Operation Unbelievable’: 1 Energy Activator, Nimble Fingers +5, Skill Expansion +5, HP Amplification +5
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Ultimate Troublemaker’: Electric Condense +5, Focus on Electric +5, Focus on Singular +5
ㄴ Upon completing ‘Fix What We Broke’: Contagion +5, Focus on Toxic +5, Focus on Tech +5

High-Value Relic Exchange 
- You can visit Reina in Albion to exchange High-Value Relics obtained from Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations for various items.
ㄴ Unlocked when you reach Mastery Rank 15 and complete an ‘Isolated Desert’ mission.
How to obtain High-Value Relics
- Today's Bonus is available once a day per zone in the Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- You can obtain 1 High-Value Relic for today's bonus, with a maximum of 2 per day.
- Today's Bonus rewards become available when you unlock the Arche Tuning System.
Exchangeable Items
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (1-Hour)
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (5-Hours)
- Unique Arche Factor EXP Boost 15% (3-Days)
- Equipment Slots +1 (Purchase limit of 100)
- Storage Slots +1 (Purchase limit of 100)


New Descendant: Serena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/e76649c936b9c9d91f3718bdd8456d7a9b502de0.png
- Added a new Descendant, Serena Antonietta.
ㄴ You can acquire Serena's blueprints, codes and materials from Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations.
Serena's Skills
- Passive: Divinity
ㄴ Serena receives bonus stats when in midair.
- Active 1: Sacred Flame
ㄴ Fires flames in the direction of the crosshair, dealing damage and inflicting Repentance on enemies and granting Blessing to allies.
ㄴ Penetrates terrain when used on the ground and explodes on contact with the ground when used in midair.
ㄴ Repentance deals continuous damage and reduces the enemy's Fire Resistance, and firearm attacks against enemies inflicted with Repentance have a chance to recover Rounds for the firearm in use.
ㄴ Blessing heals Serena for a percentage of her Max HP every second.
- Active 2: Ascension
ㄴ A toggle skill that drastically reduces gravity when used and grants various effects depending on the Rounds when attacking with a firearm in midair.
ㄴ However, using it adjusts the Grappling Hook cooldown and Jump.
ㄴ General Rounds: Increases Multi-Hit Chance and Multi-Hit Damage.
ㄴ Special Rounds: Deals AoE firearm damage to nearby targets based on the firearm damage dealt.
ㄴ Impact Rounds: Recovers MP on a critical hit.
ㄴ High-Power Rounds: Has a chance to deal additional Fire skill damage.
- Active 3: Soar
ㄴ When used on the ground, Serena soars high into the air. When used in midair, she moves quickly in the input direction.
ㄴ When used in midair, holding down the skill key makes her move for a certain period of time.
ㄴ Additionally, using the skill reloads the currently equipped weapon and resets the number of her Jumps.
- Active 4: Redemption
ㄴ When used on the ground, grants Prayer of Redemption to Serena and nearby allies.
ㄴ When used in midair, grants Redemption's Judgment to Serena.
ㄴ Prayer of Redemption significantly reduces incoming damage for a certain number of hits, and recovers HP and MP when the effect is removed.
ㄴ Redemption's Judgment deals powerful additional AoE damage to the surrounding area based on Serena's HP when she attacks with a firearm.
Skill Modules
- Skill Module 1: Divine Surge (Active 4)
ㄴ Quickly flies forward and inflicts Knockdown on collision, and deals large amounts of damage on landing.
ㄴ Creates Purifying Blaze along the path and inflicts Repentance on targets hit.
ㄴ Repentance deals continuous damage and reduces the enemy's Fire Resistance, and firearm attacks against enemies inflicted with Repentance have a chance to recover Rounds for the firearm in use.
ㄴ When used in midair, the angle of movement is adjusted in the direction of the crosshair.
- Skill Module 2: Hymn (Active 3)
ㄴ When used on the ground, Serena soars high into the air and leaves a Hymn of Exaltation on the ground, which increases the Jump of all allies within range.
ㄴ When used in midair, Serena moves and grants Hymn of Vitality to nearby allies, increasing their Movement Speed.
ㄴ Additionally, using the skill reloads the currently equipped weapon and resets the number of her Jumps.

External Components
- Added new External Components.
- New External Components can be obtained from Sigma Sector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c8790718c5cc1d68ac57c6f0e66bae0bf642ad37.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/72bfe3b942af0adf0f8206deee53a9a4c1126213.png

Module Settings Implant System
- Added the Module Settings Implant System, which allows the transfer of Module Settings applied to the Normal Descendant to the Ultimate Descendant.
- Transferring to the Ultimate Descendant requires the Photonic Implanter. 
- The Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types of the Normal Descendant can be transferred to the Ultimate Descendant as is.
ㄴ This means that both Energy Activator and Crystallization Catalyst applications are transferable.
ㄴ However, the assigned Socket Type is implanted into the same slot position, and the initial Module type of a standard Descendant is not implanted.
- After the implant, the Normal Descendant loses the Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types.
ㄴ However, any duplicate Max Capacity UP and assigned Module Socket Types applied to both Normal and Ultimate are returned as Consumables.

Arche Tuning System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/64fbeb647ad400ea667492541f2e70fda9bfd121.jpg
- Added the Arche Tuning System that enhances your Descendant's abilities. 
- The system unlocks when you complete the main quest 'Into the Storm.'
ㄴ A sub quest is available to help you understand the Arche Tuning features.
- Using the system requires Arche Tuning, which is acquired when your Unique Arche Factor level increases.
- You can increase your Unique Arche Factor level by obtaining and accumulating.
- Unique Arche Factor EXP can be obtained from various content.
Where to Obtain Unique Arche Factor EXP
ㄴ Normal Sigma Sector
ㄴ High-risk Sigma Sector
ㄴ Mission of the Day: High-risk Sigma Sector
ㄴ Void Erosion
ㄴ Void Vessel: Hard
ㄴ 400% Infiltration Operation 
- You can access the Arche Tuning System via the menu in the Inventory or at the Prime Hands.
- The Arche Tuning status is shared per Descendant Group, and the effects are also applied equally.
ㄴ Only the same Descendants (Normal, Ultimate) are treated as a single Descendant Group.
ㄴ For a Descendant Group with only the Normal Descendant, both the Normal and Ultimate will be treated as a single Descendant Group when the Ultimate is added later.
- Arche Tuning consists of multiple Nodes.
ㄴ Each Node has a Tier, and the value of a Node's applied effect is dependent on its Tier.
ㄴ Nodes require Arche Tuning to activate, and cannot be activated without it.
- You can start activating Nodes that are closest to the Tuning Starting Point.
ㄴ The Nodes that can be activated are applied with a separate effect, allowing you to discern which Nodes can be activated. 
ㄴ You can only activate Nodes that are adjacent to an activated Node.
- Activated Nodes can be reset.
ㄴ You can reset each individual Node, or all Nodes at once through Full Reset.
ㄴ Resetting returns the Arche Tuning used for activation.
- Loadouts and Presets are available.
ㄴ A total of three loadout slots are provided.
ㄴ Added a dedicated slot for Arche Tuning within Presets.
ㄴ Saved as a loadout activated at the time Preset was saved.

Special Operation Hard Difficulty Map Changes
- The map for Special Operation Hard Difficulty has been updated.  
ㄴ Resource Defense: Echo Swamp → Fortress  
ㄴ Mine Blockade: The Sterile Land → White-night Gulch  
- The EXP granted in each middle section of Special Operations on Hard Difficulty has been removed or reduced, and the same amount has been added to the EXP rewards for defeating monsters in each wave.  
- The chances of earning rewards for defeating monsters have been adjusted due to the change in the number of monsters.  
ㄴ The total EXP earned remains the same or is slightly higher than before.

Content Leaderboards
- Added a leaderboard to Void Intercept Battle (Abyss).
ㄴ You can check it on the Intercept Start screen and the Results screen of Void Intercept Battle (Abyss).
ㄴ The Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) Leaderboard ranks players by clear time.
ㄴ The Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) Leaderboard will be reset as follows:
ㆍ Reset start time: UTC+0 2025.03.13 (Thu) 07:30 ~ 2025.04.17 (Thu) 07:30
ㆍ Reset cycle: 10 weeks (70 days)
ㄴ The reset cycle for the Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard will change as follows:
ㆍ Reset start time: UTC+0 2025.03.13 (Thu) 07:30 ~ 2025.04.17 (Thu) 07:30
ㆍ Reset cycle: 5 weeks (35 days)

Four New Ultimate Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/ad6b8e787d293705cade894becb4c87fa382930d.png
(1) Malevolent (Hand Cannon)
- Acquirable from Battle Pass.
- Unique Ability: Malicious Pain
ㄴ Hitting an enemy creates a Bladed Cog.
ㄴ The Bladed Cog bounces between multiple enemies, dealing damage.
ㄴ Hitting a Weak Point creates additional Bladed Cogs.
(2) Truly Deadly Arson (Beam Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector (Normal)
- Unique Ability: Double Tap, Double Check
ㄴ Hitting an enemy inflicts Void Fire.
ㄴ When a Burn-related effect is inflicted, Void Fire explodes, dealing damage and transforming Burn to a more powerful effect, Inferno.
ㄴ Inferno nullifies Void Fire.
ㄴ Only Fire ATK applies to this weapon.
ㄴ Other Attribute ATKs are converted to Fire ATK at a certain ratio.
(3) Ancient Knight (Assault Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- Unique Ability: Descending Judgment
ㄴ Reloading in midair grants Float.
ㄴㄴ Increases ATK Drop-off Starting Distance and ATK Drop-off Ending Distance.
ㄴㄴ Hitting an enemy procs HP recovery.
ㄴ When multi-hit triggers in midair, grants Atonement.
ㄴㄴ Multi-Hit Damage increases for each stack of Atonement.
ㄴ Float and Atonement are removed when you touch the ground.
(4) A-TAMS (Sniper Rifle)
- Blueprints, codes, and materials can be obtained in Sigma Sector on High-risk Difficulty.
- Unique Ability: Electronic Arche Infusion
ㄴ When aiming, continuously consumes MP to fill the gauge.
ㄴ When firing, deals increased additional damage based on the filled gauge.

Weapon
- Capped the Fire Rate of weapons at 2000.
- Added a new stat, Multi-Hit Damage.
ㄴ Each firearm has its own value, which may vary.

Void Intercept Battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/f7f67441774d2374111f39e884944ccca5058294.jpg
- You can now check Battle Info in the Intercept Battle Entrance UI.
ㄴ The Battle Info page provides information about the stats and battle tactics of the Colossus.
Void Intercept Battles (Abyss): Tormentor
- The Colossus in the Void Intercept Battle (Abyss) has been changed to Tormentor.
- To intercept Tormentor, you must reach Mastery Rank 18 and clear the 'The Most Powerful Colossus' quest.
- Tormentor
ㄴ The Tormentor is an Electric-attributed Colossus.
ㄴ The Tormentor spawns Plasma Cubes.
ㄴ Plasma Cubes are difficult to destroy with normal attacks.
ㄴ Plasma Cubes are vulnerable to continuous damage.
ㄴ When the Tormentor enters the Void Reflux mode, it creates a thunderstorm to press the field.
ㄴ Take advantage of the Tormentor's vulnerability by actively utilizing Toxic attacks.

Photo Mode
- Added Photo Mode.
- Photo Mode is accessible through the ESC menu and can also be entered via the shortcut feature on the ring menu.
ㄴ There are no restrictions on the use of the Photo Mode feature, but it will be forcibly terminated in situations such as DBNO / death / teleport / map movement.
- You can select a pre-designated preset when entering Photo Mode.
ㄴ Presets are pre-selected shooting options for the Photo Mode, and even if you don't select a specific preset, you can set the Photo Mode options to achieve the same effects as the preset.
Preset Configuration
ㄴ Default: The default settings for Photo Mode
ㄴ Portrait: Ideal for taking portraits, applying depth of field and blurring the background.
ㄴ Background: Ideal for taking background photos, allowing you to capture a sharp shot of the entire screen.
ㄴ Load Previous Settings: You can apply the last settings you used as it. They are saved when you exit Photo Mode.
- Photo Mode Options Info

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.7
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!  

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.7, patched maintenance-free. 

 

■ Patch Date 

- 02.12.2025 (Wed) 23:00 PST 

 

■ Platforms 

- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5 

 

■ Patch Details 

 

Content Improvements  

(1) Void Erosion Purge Improvements 

- Public Operation is now available in stages 26 and 27 of Void Erosion Purge. 

- Changed the number of ranged skills of Elite Wardens from 8 to 3. 

- Removed the Chill status effect of Normal and Elite Trackers. 

- Changed the beam skills of Normal and Elite Farseers, Trackers, and Abominations so that the beam no longer rotates left or right as the target moves. 

- Changed the beam skill of the Commander monster Gruncah to slow down when it starts tracking a target. 

- Removed the guiding ability from the skills of Normal and Elite Annihilators and Living Artillery. 

- The drop rate of all tiers of General Rounds, Special Rounds, Impact Rounds, and High-Power Rounds has doubled compared to the previous rate. 

- Changed the reward distribution rules for Void Erosion Purge so that clear rewards are awarded upon completion of the mission regardless of the penalty duration. 

- Changed monster combinations and spawn patterns for Void Erosion Purge stages 21-30. 

ㄴ Reduced the spawn proportion of Suicide Bombers in stages 21/24/27 (5% → 1.7%) 

ㄴ Changed the Commander that appears in Stage 29 from Dmigor to Plaudia. 

Legion of Darkness 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Living Artillery (33% → 20%) 

Legion of Immortality 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Farseers (33% → 20%) 

ㄴ Reduced the number of Trackers spawning 

ㄴ Farseers and Trackers no longer spawn together 

ㄴ Removed Fortress Guards 

Order of Truth 

ㄴ Changed the group spawn chance of Annihilators (33% → 20%) 

ㄴ Reduced the number of Wardens spawning 

ㄴ Annihilators and Wardens no longer spawn together 

ㄴ Removed Ascetics. 

- Reduced the difficulty of Solo mode in Void Erosion Purge. 

- Increased Attribute ATK of weapons in Void Erosion Purge. 

- Nerfed Commander Monsters for 2-4 player modes in Void Erosion Purge. 

 

(2) Descendants 

[Ines] 

- The increase in the number of hits according to the Skill Range of Ines now changes when the Skill Range module is equipped. 

ㄴ Applied to the base skills Chain Lightning, Lightning Conductor, and Snare Hunter. 

ㄴ Applied to Floating Lightning of the skill module Time of the Hunting Hounds. 

[Keelan] 

- The increase in the number of targets according to the Skill Range of Keelan now changes when the Skill Range module is equipped. 

ㄴ Applied to the base skill Void Corrosion. 

 

(3) Weapons & Modules 

- Fixed the brightness of Albion Cavalry Gun's Ricochet effect being too bright in certain areas. 

- Made some improvements to the weapon stats and unique abilities of three Ultimate Weapons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/9f63d9aef935792c884fb25ac5cf8cee028bebcf.png

- The weapon slot in use no longer changes when moving between fields. 

- Increased Firearm ATK of some Rare weapons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/05f2941c1624db768087f2859776036737507d41.png

(4) UI&UX  

- Changed the Purchase button assignment as below depending on the use of Caliber. 

Buttons for non-Caliber spending purchases  

ㄴ PC: Space Bar / PS: X / Xbox: A 

Buttons for Caliber spending purchases 

ㄴ PC: F / PS: X / Xbox: A 

ㄴ A hold time of 0.5s now applies in all cases 

ㄴ Changed Accelerate Research so that you now have to press the Accelerate button directly. 

- In NPC shops, such as Deslin and Anais, you can now check the item tooltip and acquisition information at Currency Info at the top of the screen. 

- In Void Erosion Purge, the key for Next Stage has been changed to F → N on PC.  

 

(5) Products  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b0d84cc5e43f2c651c811371eb49f3145d8b5b59.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/614ba9d9909bdb8d2dca125e18bd46172c4bf57f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c989ec139cceef83055334da398d2f4243641796.png

Events  

(1) Challenge Events 

- The 'Operation: Kate's Experiment Assistant' event will run from after 02.12.2025 (Wed) hotfix to 02.26.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ Daily challenges and event challenges have been added.  

- The "Operation Initiation" event will run from after the hotfix on 02.12.2025 (Wed) PST until 02.18.2025 (Tue) 22:59 PST. 

ㄴ During the event period, Descendants who log in at least once will receive a special customization item. 

- The 'Operation: Burning Embers' event will run from 02.26.2025 (Wed) 23:00 to 03.12.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ Daily challenges and Event challenges will be added.  

 

(2) Login Event 

- The 'Operation: Daily Report' login event will run from 02.12.2025 (Wed) hotfix to 03.12.2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.  

ㄴ The login event will run for 14 days. 

ㄴ Rewards include emotes, Ecive skins, and various materials and consumables. 

ㄴ Login everyday during the event to earn various rewards! 

 

※ For more information, please see 'Kate's Experiment: Call of the Flame Event Info' announcement.  

Bug Fixes 

(1) Content 

- When all Descendants in the No Resurrection Zone are DNO, they will now be respawned. 

ㄴ The restart count will be deducted. 

ㄴ They will respawn at a location just before the No Resurrection Zone. 

 

(2) Descendants 

- Fixed an issue where the effect icons for Lepic's Overclock, Power Unit Change, and Nerve Infiltration did not match the skill icons. 

- Partially fixed an issue where Luna's notes were delayed.  

ㄴ Fixed an issue where the music and notes would get out of sync in certain situations by removing the problematic notes at regular intervals to resync them. 

 

(3) Weapons & Modules 

- Fixed an issue where Auto-Equip for Descendant Modules would not proceed if the cursor was hovering over a Module slot by changing the key to a different button. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/3c62cc937cf167c404aa4da27cbf3400e1f5a26a.png

(4) UI&UX 

- Fixed an issue where Craft Core screen would show misalignment when the player has a large number of Cores or Core Amplifiers.  

- Changed the gamepad buttons for skipping the cutscene for Weapon Readjustment. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/e0a0f14e432f29d007ed97c67b8585458534dd60.png

- UI theme customization can now be applied to leaderboards.  

 

(5) Miscellaneous 

- Fixed an issue where some Fellow body skins were not shown when equipped.  

- Fixed an issue where other players could enter the Laboratory. 

- Fixed an issue where the dungeon icon was shown intermittently at the top left of the mini-map.  

- Fixed the unnatural wrinkles on the buttocks of Ines' default skin. 




# Director’s Comment 


Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.  

As I mentioned on Discord and Dev Livestream, this hotfix focuses on improving the gameplay experience of Void Erosion Purge while addressing elements that may have caused discomfort.   

However, the issue of certain weapon metas being overly required at higher difficulty levels has not yet been fully resolved. The reason we couldn't address this issue immediately is due to the performance gap between Descendants.   

If we balance the difficulty based on top-tier Descendants, most other Descendants will struggle to play effectively. Conversely, if we adjust the difficulty to accommodate lower-performing Descendants, the leaderboard risks being dominated by only a selected few, diminishing the content’s value as a challenge.   

To fundamentally resolve this issue, we plan to first adjust the balance between Descendants and then refine the gameplay experience of Void Erosion Purge. However, with the ongoing preparation for Season 2 Episode 2 and live service management, we regret that we cannot implement these improvements as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for this delay. We will share further details as soon as we finalize our improvement plans and schedule.   

We deeply apologize to all players who may have been disappointed with the Void Erosion Purge content. To deliver better content, we will actively seek ways to engage with the community and gather feedback before updates, ensuring a more stable live service experience.   

Thank you, as always, for your valuable feedback. 


 Thank you.
