notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.6
notes.notes:
# 2025.02.06 (Thu) 03:00 PST – Content Improvements > (4) UI & UX

Greetings, Descendants! 


Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.6.


■ Patch Schedule
- 2025.02.05(Wed) 23:00 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Update 1.2.6

Content Leaderboards
- Added the Leaderboards menu.
- The leaderboards can be checked in the Journal menu.
- The leaderboards display top 100 players.
- The leaderboards are separated according to the number of players who entered the content. (Solo, 2-player, 3-player, 4-player)
- For the Solo leaderboard, rankings are aggregated for each Descendant played.
ㄴ There are separate leaderboards for Ultimate Descendants and Normal Descendants.
- You can keep track of the records for each of your Descendant in one place.
- A notification is displayed when a new record is set.
ㄴ Enter Rankings: Top 10 overall on the leaderboard
ㄴ Solo: Top 100 overall on the Solo leaderboard
ㄴ My Record: Set a new personal record
Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard 
- Added a leaderboard to Void Erosion Purge.
- The leaderboard can be checked on the Void Erosion Purge entry screen and the Void Erosion Purge results screen.
- The Void Erosion Purge leaderboard ranks players based on their cleared stages and time. 
ㄴ The cleared stages take precedence over clear time.
ㄴ Clear time includes death penalty time.
- The Void Erosion Purge leaderboard is reset at the end of the season.
ㄴ The reset cycle for the Void Erosion Purge leaderboard may change in the future.

Craft Core
- Added Craft Core.
- Cores can be crafted through Deslin.
- Three Cores of the same tier as the Augmentation type and one Core Amplifier are used to craft one Core of the next tier.
ㄴ Core Amplifiers can be obtained from Void Erosion Purge.
ㄴ The higher the Core tier, the more Gold is required to craft it.
- If 'Auto-craft lower stages' is checked when crafting a Core, all identical Augmentation Cores of a lower tier than the Core to be crafted will be automatically registered as materials and consumed for crafting. 
ㄴ To use only Cores that are one tier lower as materials, uncheck the 'Auto-craft lower stages' checkbox. 
- You can select the quantity to craft by moving the slider, and reducing the quantity deducts lower tier Cores first as materials.
ㄴ The maximum quantity that can be crafted at one time is 300.

Void Erosion Purge Zone Addition
- New difficulties for Void Erosion Purge stages 21 to 30 have been added. 
ㄴ The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards you can obtain. 
ㄴ Public matching is available at stages 21, 25, 28, 29, and 30.
- Added Core Amplifiers to the reward for completing Void Erosion Purge.
- In the Void Erosion Purge zone, ATK is significantly amplified when using attributes that resonate with the void attribute. 
ㄴ Up to stage 20, the ATK amplification effect was strong.
ㄴ From stage 21 onwards, the ATK amplification effect gradually weakens. 
ㄴ As you get closer to the final stage, the powerful influence of Void Erosion further reduces the skill's ATK.
- Purify all eroded zones to protect Albion from the dangers of the Void.

Laboratory Improvements 
- You can now change the Vulgus level in the Laboratory to up to 260.
- You can now summon the Colossi from already completed Intercept Battles in the Laboratory.
ㄴ You can set up and summon them in the Laboratory Settings > Colossus tab.
- Added a feature to view the damage you have inflicted in the Laboratory.


■ Hotfix 1.2.6

Content Improvements 
(1) Void Erosion Purge
- Changed the placement of the Void Erosion Purge Hard CC Immunity Guide UI display.
- Added UI for the legions that appear in each Void Erosion Purge stage and their Weak Point Types information.

(2) Support Request Bulletin 
- Expired support requests are now deleted immediately.
- The Refresh button is now always displayed even if there are no support requests.

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed the brightness of the beam being too bright in certain areas when using Voltia.
- Increased the maximum number of modules that you can own to 2,000.

(4) UI&UX
- Using Ecive now displays markers that differentiate Elite and Common monsters. 
- Changed the HP bar color of Elite monsters.  
- Added a marker to missions that can be played as Public Operations on the Void Erosion Purge mission selection screen.
- Changed the UX so that the options to apply are now selected and applied on the Core Equip Results screen.
- Improved visibility by adding spaces between the Core option and the tier value.
- The Core option tier values that were previously displayed in Arabic numerals in some languages are now displayed in Roman numerals.
- Added a hold time to the Purchase button that applies when Caliber is used immediately without moving to the Shop while playing the game.
ㄴ Accelerating Research
ㄴ Purchasing Battle Pass
ㄴ Purchasing presets/equipment/loadouts/storage slots
ㄴ Purchasing Customize paints
- (Added) Keyboard and mouse support has been enabled for console devices.

Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue that caused the monster, Chain Explosive No. 2 Commander, which appears in the Vulgus Strategic Outpost, to stutter when appearing.
- Fixed the Void Erosion Purge time icon and line image being out of sync.
- Fixed the Hard CC Immunity UI that was displayed in Void Erosion Purge stages where Hard CC Immunity Elites do not appear so that it is no longer displayed in those stages.
- In Void Erosion Purge, pressing the Next Stage button now properly matchmakes based on the Public/Private Operation status.
- Fixed an issue where monsters were not summoned when detected by a drone in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where some drones respawned with awkward animations in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where after clearing an outpost, the objects inside it were not visible. 

(2) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where the Singular Skill Power Modifier did not apply correctly to the damage of Enzo’s skill, Concentrated Fire, when he was equipped with the Concentrated Fire module
- Fixed an issue where Valby's jumping motion did not display correctly when she was equipped with the Tidal Wave module.

(3) Weapons & Modules
- Fixed an issue where equipping the Explosion Range module did not affect the effect size.
ㄴ Death Roar, Guardian R4, Lightspeed Barrel, Tamed Beast, Sigvore's Proof, Vestigial Organ
- Fixed an issue where some Module effects of Beam Rifles and Launchers were not displayed in weapon information. 
ㄴ Beam Rifle – Charging Speed Increase 
ㄴ Launcher - Explosion Radius Increase

(4) UI&UX
- Fixed an issue where the Acquired locations of Hunter External Components listed the Story Dungeon. 
- Fixed an issue where the inaccessible Void Abyss Intercept Battle was not displayed as inactive in the Acquired list.
- Fixed the Acquisition Information of items obtainable in Special Operations to indicate the difficulty level.
- Fixed Void Erosion Purge so that party members cannot press the Next Stage button after clearing a stage.
- Fixed the page jump button to be disabled during Void Erosion Purge matching.
- Fixed an issue where the information on the Void Erosion Purge results screen was not properly displayed when network conditions were poor.

(5) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the setting for the Hide System Messages option would reset on client restart.
- Fixed the range and duration of Ecive that were unintentionally nerfed.
- Fixed an issue where the Next Stage button in Void Erosion Purge did not work when there was another button assigned to Next Stage.

Thank you.

# Director's Comments


Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.
Today, I’d like to briefly share some news about our upcoming update.

As mentioned in the previous Dev Live, we will be skipping the hotfix scheduled for January 30, which coincides with the Korean Lunar New Year holiday. Instead, we are focusing on preparing for the 1.2.6 minor update, scheduled for release on February 6. This update will include support for keyboard and mouse on consoles, along with platform certifications during this period. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to delivering the minor update on February 6. 

1.2.6 Minor Update on February 6 will add Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard, 10 Tiers of Augmentation Cores, and 30 stages of Void Erosion Purge. Let's see the content advanced with some screenshots.

Void Erosion Purge Leaderboard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/0a711d552d355d47d167c7eeb5d06c09ce49253e.jpg
(The records shown above are from the test server and irrelevant to actual gameplay.) 

We are introducing a leaderboard for Void Erosion Purge that showcases the top players who complete the highest stages in the fastest time. You’ll be able to view rankings not only by platform but also by individual Descendants. Use the leaderboard to study the most effective builds and compete with other Descendants to set record-breaking clear times! 

Augmentation Core Upgrade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/02e5dae8f45c8956fa51bdc53d618fa4177f7bb2.jpg

Craft Core can be accessed through Deslin—yes, it’s Deslin again! 😊  
This system allows you to combine lower-tier Augmentation Cores and materials obtained from Void Erosion Purge to create higher-tier Cores. With this update, you’ll be able to craft up to Tier 10 Augmentation Cores, empowering your Ultimate Weapons to reach their full potential. 

Void Erosion Purge Stage 30
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/502e26f2bcfec84323d6e399dc862e01661edb72.jpg

New stages, ranging from 21 to 30, will be added to Void Erosion Purge. 
These stages are significantly more challenging than Stage 20 and will introduce new environments to enhance the experience. The higher the stage, the better the rewards, such as higher-tier Augmentation Cores, but the difficulty will also increase accordingly. Prepare carefully and challenge these new stages to compete on the leaderboard rankings.

In addition to these updates, we’ve prepared various quality-of-life improvements, which will be detailed in a future update patch note. Also, mark your calendars for February 13, when we will release a winter hot spring-themed update. We’ll unveil new skins and share more details about future updates in early February during the next Dev Live, so stay tuned.

As we celebrate the Lunar New Year here in Korea, I’d like to take this opportunity to send my warmest regards to all our global Descendants. May this year be filled with health and happiness for you and your loved ones. We will continue to work hard to bring you joyful experiences throughout the year.

Thank you.

PST 2025.01.15 (Wed) 22:00 – Hotfix 1.2.4 > Content Improvements > (5) Descendants > The skill information for ‘Valby’ and ‘Ultimate Valby’ regarding the ‘Bubble Bullet’ skill has been updated.


Greetings, Descendants.

 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Update 1.2.4.

 

■ Platforms

- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

 

■ Update 1.2.4


Ultimate Weapon: Weapon Core Unlock
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b919900fd4b6be21beb00b531463f1e97b7b6ef7.png

 - Weapon Core Unlock system that upgrades performances of Ultimate Weapons has been added.

Basic Info

- Reach Mastery Rank 18 and complete Sub Quest  and proceed through NPC Deslin.
- One Lv. 100 Ultimate Weapon and one Core Binder are required to unlock a core.

Unlock Core

- When you unlock a Core using the correct weapon and Core Binder that meet the conditions, 5 Core Slots will be unlocked.
- Each slot has an assigned core type. The assigned type unlocked depends on the weapon used, and you may have several of the same type.
- You can equip Core items assigned by the Core slot type, and it also determines the type of option.
- Weapons with unlocked Cores cannot be dismantled or sold.

Options List by Core Type

- Firepower Augmentation: Firearm ATK (Explosive ATK for Launcher), extra Firearm ATK for Attacks on Colossus
- Hit Augmentation: Weak Point Damage, Firearm Critical Hit Rate, Firearm Critical Hit Damage
- Attribute Augmentation: Fire ATK, Chill ATK, Electric ATK, Toxic ATK
- Tactical Augmentation: Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate, Rounds per Magazine, Fire Rate, Reload Time Modifier, Beam Rifle Charging Speed (available for Beam Rifles only)
- Precision Augmentation: Recoil, Hip Fire Accuracy, Weapon Change Speed, Sprint Speed, Grappling Hook Charge Time Increase Rate, Aimed Shot Accuracy
- Special Augmentation: Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Legion of Darkness, Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Order of Truth, Extra Firearm ATK when attacking Legion of Immortality
- Free Augmentation: Can equip any Core item without limit. The option is determined by the type of equipped Core item.

Equip Core

- You can equip Core items to weapons that had their Cores unlocked.
ㄴ When you equip a Core item, the option is determined according to the Core type.
- Core items have Tiers. They are marked in Roman numerals (e.g., I, II, III, etc.) and the higher the tier, the better effect values they have.
ㄴ Each option has a set value range according to the Core item's tier, and the value is given within the range.
- You may also overwrite a Core item already equipped to a slot with another Core item. However, this process requires a "Core Particle Disruptor."
ㄴ When overwriting a Core item, you may choose from the existing effects and changes effects. If you do not like the new effect, choose to keep the existing one.
ㄴ However, the Core item and Core Particle Disruptor will still be consumed even if you decide to keep the existing effect.

Where to Obtain Materials

- Core Binder, an item required for Core Unlock, can be crafted through Research after collecting Void Abyss Metal Fragments from Void Intercept Battle (Void Abyss) and Infiltration Operation 400%.
- Core Particle Disruptor, an item required for Core replacement, can also be crafted through Research after collecting Void Abyss Metal Fragments.
- Core items can be acquired from Void Erosion Purge. Core items with higher tiers can be found from higher difficulties.

Quests

- When you reach Mastery Rank 18, you can see the Sub Quest  You may proceed to Core Unlock by talking to NPC Deslin after completing the quest received from the Descendant Instructor.



Ultimate Weapon: Added Basic Attribute Damage

- Basic Attribute Damage has been added to some Ultimate Weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/a025c36d6d791dc8927b10b70462febed975e039.png


New Descendant: Ines

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/8ebbb62f989aff107dcb4fba5fe6dfcec339ea4e.png
- Added a new Descendant, Ines.
ㄴ You can acquire research blueprints, codes, and materials from the Void Vessel Hard Difficulty.

Ines's Skills

- Passive: Plasma Oscillation
ㄴ The higher the Max MP, the greater Skill Critical Hit Rate increase.
ㄴ Critical Hits on enemies in Conductor state cause Dark Current, dealing chain damages to nearby enemies.
ㄴ Inflict Conductor Status Effect to enemies hit by the skill and deal additional damages to enemies that are already in Conductor state.

- Active 1: Chain Lightning
ㄴ Cast a jumping Lightning that affects multiple enemies to deal damage. When there is a single enemy, the Lightning jumps between the enemy and Ines repeatedly to deal damage.

- Active 2: Lightning Conductor
ㄴ Inflict damage through Current Coils to nearby enemies and generate Current Coils to all enemies in conductor state to deal damage.

- Active 3: Discharge
ㄴ This skill gathers Electricity and discharges forward with a great force. The damage increases as you charge the skill (by holding the button), and when the button is released at the peak, it deals the most damage.

- Active 4: Snare Hunter
ㄴ It throws Plasma Acceleration Coil forward to cast a Thunder Snare where it lands.
ㄴ Thunder Snare deals damage to the nearby area at regular intervals. It also generates Current Coils covering a broader area at longer intervals to deal damage.
ㄴ Ines enters a Short Circuit state when using the skill. Short Circuit state fixes Dark Current damage at maximum and increases Movement Speed.

Skill Module

- Skill Module 1: Plasma Ball
ㄴ Unlike the existing passive skill "Plasma Oscillation," it does not boost Skill Critical Hit Rate but generates Plasma Ball that defends incoming attacks from enemies for a better stability.
ㄴ The durability of Plasma Ball increases in relation to the Max MP.
ㄴ It additionally allows the character hits enemies that have conductors with a skill to deal Dark Current even without Critical Hit.
ㄴ Inflict Conductor Status Effect to enemies hit by the skill and deal additional damages to enemies that are already in Conductor state.
ㄴ You can acquire it from Kingston: Slumber Valley Hard difficulty, Obstructer Hard difficulty, and Combine Module.

- Skill Module 2: Time of the Hunting Hounds
ㄴ Active 1: Floating Lightning: Unlike Chain Lightning, it hits a small number of enemies but changes to stacking skill with a reduced Cooldown.
ㄴ Active 3 Snare Acrobatics: Gather lightning in both hands and charge forward with force. Deal damage to all targets in the path of the charge and cause a powerful explosion at the end of the path to deal damage to nearby targets. Unlike the existing Discharge Skill, its Damage, Move Distance, and Explosion Range at the final point increase with the charging stack.

- You can acquire it from Hagios: The Haven (Hard Difficulty), Frost Walker (Hard Difficulty), and Module Combine.


New Content: Void Erosion Purge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/60fec9df9908fdcd8157b43e819e44ca732b5425.png

 - Added Void Erosion Purge, a new dungeon content that allows you to challenge increasingly more difficult Difficulty.

Unlock Requirements

- Reach Mastery Rank 18, talk to the NPC Descendant Instructor and complete the quest  to unlock.
Entry Method
- The Void Erosion Purge can be accessed via the Infiltration Operations Terminal or the Void Erosion icon on the World Map.

Content Play Guide

- There are a total of 20 stages in Void Erosion Purge.
- Players start at stage 1 and the rest of the stages are locked.
- After starting the Erosion Purge, you'll need to defeat Vulgus legions to fill the target gauge. Once the gauge is full, the final Named Boss will appear. Defeat the boss to complete the Void Erosion Purge.
- Complete Erosion Purge to lock the next stage.

Determination of Outcome

- Erosion Purge Complete: If you complete the mission in the target time of 10 minutes, you will receive the rewards and unlock the next stage.
- Mission Complete: If you complete the mission but exceed the target time of 10 minutes, you will receive the rewards, but the next stage won't be unlocked.
- Mission Failed: If you fail to complete the mission and exceed all 15 minutes of playtime, you will not receive the rewards, and the next stage won't be unlocked.

Public Matchmaking

- Stage 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17 allows you to use matchmaking .
- All the other stages allow  only.

Reward Info

- Core items can be acquired as loots from defeated monsters in each stage or Mission Completion Rewards of each stage.

Miscellaneous

- When a Descendant is killed, the target time is reduced by 24 seconds. Frequent deaths may make unlocking the next stage more difficult.
- Arche Obstruction (Attribute Barrier), a new Elite effect by legion appears in Void Erosion Purge.
- Arche Obstruction (Attribute Barrier) reduces damage from the same Attribute by 81%.
ㄴ Legion of Darkness - Arche Obstruction (Fire)
ㄴ Legion of Immortality - Arche Obstruction (Electric)
ㄴ Legion of Truth - Arche Obstruction (Toxic)
- You may see the information of the Vulgus legion and their elite effects at the Void Erosion Purge Stage selection screen.
- Stage 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 spawns Elites that have crowd control abilities, requiring a high level of battle concentration from players.


Void Intercept Battle Void Abyss: Defiler

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/20aa94a49f4076d54d8a17c50e9e5894279d75c5.png

Features of Defiler

- It creates Abyss Symbiont to strengthen itself

- When it enters the "Void Reflux mode," it charges in like a bull.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants. 

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.2.2, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- 12.18.2024 (Wed) 18:15 PST

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details
Content Improvements 
(1) Balance: Intercept Battles
- Molten Fortress and Gluttony Intercept Battles have been changed to allow for solo matchmaking.
- The following nerfs have been applied to Molten Fortress and Gluttony:
※ If you have not downloaded the Hotfix 1.2.2 update, you may be able to enter the Void Intercept Battle solo without the difficulty adjustment applied. Please make sure to update your game before participating in the Intercept Mission.
Molten Fortress
ㄴ If the beam of a Frenzy Suppressor is linked correctly to another device during the Frenzied state, this device can no longer be operated or changed afterward.
ㄴ Adjusted the spawn timing of Frenzy Suppressors to spawn when the Molten Fortress rises from the ground during its Frenzied state.
ㄴ Adjusted the number of Roly-poly summoned by the Molten Fortress from 8 to 4 during the Normal state and 6 during the Frenzied state.
ㄴ Molten Fortress now enters the Frenzied state less frequently.
Gluttony
ㄴ Adjusted the Impurity to be drawn to Gluttony when they are within a 15m radius of Gluttony.
ㄴ Adjusted the amount of the Wipe Attack Gauge that increases when the Unstable Energy is absorbed by Gluttony from 20% to 10%.
ㄴ Unstable Energy explosions required to cancel the Frenzied state now doubled, making it easier to cancel.
ㄴ Gluttony now moves around the center of the map more frequently.
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of Gluttony's Melee Attack (raking the ground with its arms) from 5 seconds to 20 seconds.
ㄴ Adjusted Gluttony's basic shotgun attack so that it can be used at close range.
ㄴ Gluttony now enters the Frenzied state less frequently.
ㄴ Reduced Gluttony's ATK by approximately 47.4%.

(2) Balance: Reactors
- The "Attribute Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Reactors of the same Attribute.
ㄴ The "Chill Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Chill Reactors.
ㄴ The "Non-Attribute Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Non-Attribute Reactors.
ㄴ The "Fire Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Fire Reactors.
ㄴ The "Toxic Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Toxic Reactors.
ㄴ The "Electric Power Boost Ratio" random option can only be acquired from Electric Reactors.
ㄴ The "HP Heal Modifier" random option can only be acquired from Non-Attribute Reactors.

(3) Balance: Descendants
- Adjusted the duration of Active Camouflage when using Ultimate Sharen's skill module "Ambushed" from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.
- Adjusted the cooldown of some of Keelan's skills.
ㄴ Septic Gust: 60 seconds → 35 seconds
ㄴ Tremor: 80 seconds → 60 seconds
- Adjusted Keelan's Skill Module "Focus on Prey."
ㄴ Adjusted the damage per Acidic Decay stack of Tremor.
Lv. 1: 470.3% → 655.5%
Lv. 2: 480% → 670%
Lv. 3: 488.6% → 683%
Lv. 4: 494.8% → 692.2%
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of the Void Corrosion skill from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
- Adjusted Keelan's Skill Module "Mobile Strike."
ㄴ Adjusted the cooldown of the Hunting Time skill from 150 seconds to 55 seconds. 
ㄴ Adjusted the duration of the Adventurer's Spirit effect of Hunting Time from 3 seconds to 4 seconds. It is now affected by the "'Skill Duration Increase" stat.
ㄴ Keelan cannot move to a higher position by using the Onslaught skill while the Adventurer's Spirit effect is active. The delay after pressing the skill button has been reduced.

(4) Content
- Added the "Start Private Operation" feature to Special Operations.
ㄴ The difficulty level will not be adjusted according to the number of players. Only the individual/party that has applied to enter will be able to participate in the Special Operation.
- Changed the Sphere mechanic of Commander monsters that appear in the following content to the Monster Extermination mechanic.
ㄴ Kingston: Slumber Vally (Normal/400%), Magister Lab (400%), and Albion Resource Defense (Normal/Hard)
ㄴ Sterile Land: Unknown Laboratory (400%), The Forgottense (400%), Kuiper Refinery (Normal/Had), Repository: Vulgus Strategic Outpost (Normal/Hard), and Kuiper Mine Blockade (Normal)
ㄴ Vespers: The Shelter (Normal), Void Fusion Reactor - Vespers Ruins (Normal/Hard), Void Fusion Reactor - Vespers Lost Supply Depot (Normal/Hard), and Moonlight Lake: Vulgus Strategic Outpost (Normal/Hard)
ㄴ Fortress: Quarantine Zone (400%) and Albion Resource Defense (Normal/Hard)
- Amorphous Material Patterns that can be obtained from the Outposts in each Zone can now be earned as Selectable Rewards in Infiltration Operations in the same Zone.
ㄴ Upon completing a mission on Normal Difficulty, you can earn 1 Amorphous Material Pattern.
ㄴ Upon completing a mission on Hard Difficulty, you can earn up to 2 patterns depending on your total score based on the Kill Score Multiplier.
- Falling or cancelling Grappling Hooks no longer counts as jumping. 

(5) UI & UX
- Improved the Library to display the Research progress in the Details based on the actual Research status.
- On PC, opening the Ring Menu now moves the cursor to the center of the Ring Menu.

(6) Miscellaneous
- Added "Quick Turn" as an option in Controller > Normal Button Settings > User Settings.
ㄴ The button for this feature is not included in the Default settings and needs to be set separately. 
ㄴ If Sprint is set as the movement option, using the L3 button makes it easier to use this feature. 
- When a Commander monster's phase changes, the movement location guide is now displayed for a longer duration.
- The difficulty of the Valby Evolving Skin quests has been reduced.
ㄴ Stage 2: Pass through 10,000 enemies with the Clean Up skill → 3,000 enemies
ㄴ Stage 3: Pass through 20,000 enemies with the Clean Up skill → 6,500 enemies


Bug Fixes
(1) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where using Esiemo's Arche Explosion or Creative Explosion skill during an Emote displayed the incorrect motions.
- Fixed an issue where Turrets could be removed when using Jayber's Reactivate or Immediate Purge Code skill.
- Fixed an issue where Jayber's other skills were not available when using his Reactivate or Immediate Purge Code skill.

(2) Weapons & Modules

(3) UI/UX
- Fixed an issue where the Owned icons on Descendant portraits would disappear when scrolling on the Usage Information screen of the Common Skins in the Customize menu.
- Fixed an issue where the color change shortcut button was not displayed in the tooltip of the Fellow Skin equipped in the Customize menu.
- Fixed an issue where entering the game through the "Go to the Last Played Map" would reset the Junk Filter.
- Fixed an issue where attempting to check the Details of an equipped Emote in the User Settings menu of the Ring Menu did not display the Details and unequipped the Emote instead.
- Fixed an issue where, after removing a Target Reward, clicking the empty slot in the Target Reward List would freeze the game on PC. 
- Fixed an issue where the discount rate was not applied correctly when purchasing Bundles that included already-owned components. 
- Fixed an issue where the text "Exclusive Item" was not displayed for some products.

(4) Miscellaneous
- Fixed an issue where the Dread Armor Force did not trigger the trap mechanics normally in the Void Vessel. 
- Fixed an issue where the amount of Gold earned on the Results screen of a Special Operation on Hard Difficulty sometimes displayed the amount of Gold owned. 
- Fixed an issue where the ETA Intercept Battle, Infiltration, and Supplies Exchange awards were not checked.
- Fixed an issue where your Target Reward gauge would reset if another player obtained your Target Reward item during Void Intercept Battle.
- Fixed an issue where the default skin was not displayed after dismissing the Descendant.

Thank you.

Content Improvements 
(1) Addition of Infiltration Support Function 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/d072baa8076e99986ba79c33cd5c2a115b2c4b04.png
- When starting an Infiltration, you can activate the "Other Infiltration Support" setting.
ㄴ Activating this option allows you to enter different Infiltration Operations from the currently selected one, with a low number of Descendants.
ㄴ Infiltration Support targets Operations that have the same Difficulty and Kill Score Multiplier as the one selected.
ㄴ You cannot carry out Private Operations when Other Infiltration Support is enabled.
- Other Infiltration Support is unavailable under the following conditions.
ㄴ You can only support Infiltration Operations that you have cleared at least once on Normal Difficulty.
ㄴ Other Infiltration Support is unavailable on Hard Difficulty with the 400% multiplier.
ㄴ Other Infiltration Support is unavailable if you're in a 4-player party.
- Rewards available from Other Infiltration Support are as follows.
ㄴ Rewards dropped from enemies are based on the Infiltration Operation currently being played.
ㄴ Infiltration Operation Success Rewards are based on the Infiltration Operation that was selected.
ㄴ Selectable Rewards for Hard Difficulty Infiltration Operations are also based on the Infiltration Operation that was selected.
ㄴ The drop rate of the Selectable Rewards is determined by the score table of the Infiltration Operation that you entered.
Quests
- When clearing an Infiltration Operation, the quest progress increases based on the Infiltration Operation that you entered.

(2) Balance
- Upon entering content, the capacity of High-Power Rounds has been increased from 5 to 15.
- The base ‘Weapon Spec’ of the next ultimate weapons have been adjusted
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘After Glow’ has been increased from 6 to 12.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Piercing Light has been increased from 6 to 11.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Smithereens’ has been increased from 7 to 15.
ㄴ The basic ammo capacity of ‘Executor’ has been increased from 8 to 14.

(2) Descendants

notes.title: Plans for Season 2 Update Content Issues
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants.  

 

We are planning to address issues arising from the main content updates in Season 2.  
We will provide additional updates to this notice as the preparations progress. 

 
■ Improvement of Misunderstood Participation Conditions Due to Void Vessel Quest Path Issues 

The Void Vessel content becomes accessible via the Void Vessel Operations Terminal after completing the quest Unidentified Void Vessel Exploration Mission (Void Vessel tutorial completed once). You can then participate in Void Vessel: Normal and Void Vessel: Hard. 

However, due to unclear quest guidance, many players have misunderstood that they must complete the Data Recorder Collection stage to progress. This has caused difficulties for many players attempting to complete the quest. 
To address this issue, we plan to implement the following changes in the 1.2.0c hotfix scheduled for Saturday, December 7. 

The ‘Collect Recording Devices’ will be converted into a side quest. 
The Move to Void Vessel for Data Collection button will now be redirected to the Void Vessel Operations Terminal. 
These changes aim to clearly distinguish quests that are not mandatory and help players easily recognize that they can already play Void Vessel Operations.  

Additionally, we plan to further refine the ‘Collect Recording Devices’ side quest through a future hotfix for a smoother gameplay experience. 
You can freely play the Void Vessel Dungeon via terminal after completing the tutorial once. Players who prioritize combat and farming over story progression can complete this quest later at their convenience. 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and will continue striving to provide a better gaming experience. 

 

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants! 

Here are the details for The First Descendant Update 1.2.0.

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

New Episode: Void Chaser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/bb74baa96a30a6f99e8a1a3844a9fd4b90f42986.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/850c07746bf75ba483589b95a9d00eb97016e435.png

ㄴ Various Champion Vulgus: Champion effects such as “Legion Shield” that can be destroyed with Descendant Skills, “Arche Obstruction” that can only be destroyed with firearms are added.  
ㄴ Void Vessel Commander “Dread Armor Force” has been added as a new commander Vulgus. 
ㄴ One from three random paths are chosen for the Void Vessel Operation.
ㄴ You can acquire blueprints and materials for Fellow Enhancement Item research, materials for Keelan research, and Crystallization Catalyst research materials by inboxes that can be found on your way.
ㄴ Various tiers of Data Vaults appear per the Commander defeat time, and you can acquire research blueprints, code for the new Descendant Keelan or Fellow, and Crystallization Catalyst research material.	 
ㄴ If you already own a Fellow, the reward acquisition chance of Data Vault changes.

New Descendant: Keelan

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b02d41fe7863afa418906b0da9528cc685eb8176.jpg

- The new Descendant “Keelan” is added.
ㄴ You can acquire research blueprints, codes, and materials from the Void Vessel.

Keelan Skills
- Erosion: Using the skill increases the “Acidic Infusion Level” and grants “Agility” at every certain number of times. “Agility” effect increases the Skill Power and Movement Speed with each stack.
- Void Corrosion: Target an enemy to fire “Void Corrosion” and inflict “Acidic Decay” to the hit target. As the “Effect Range” increases, the number of “Max Target Count” increases, inflicting “Additional DMG” to enemies that are already affected by “Acidic Decay.” 
- Onslaught: Dash forward to deal Damage to the pierced target and cause an explosion when completed to deal “Damage” and “Knockback” to nearby enemies. It inflicts “Acidic Decay” effect to the hit target and “Additional DMG” to enemies that are already affected by “Acidic Decay.” “Stack Cooldown” is decreased by a certain amount per the number of enemies pierced. While dashing, you do not receive DMG from some traps.
- Septic Gust: Deal Damage and inflict “Acidic Decay” to enemies within the range. Enemies already inflicted with “Acidic Decay” get “Blood Rot” effect. Enemies inflicted with “Blood Rot” explode after a certain period of time, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
- Tremor: If there are enemies within the range inflicted with “Acidic Decay,” deal Damage in proportion of the stacks count of the target’s “Acidic Decay.” If there are no enemies within range affected by “Acidic Decay,” the current stacks of "Onslaught" will increase.

Skill Module
- Focus on Prey: “Void Corrosion” is converted to target a single target rather than multiple targets with an increased “Fire Count.” The “Max Stacks” of “Acidic Decay” is increased, increasing the peak of “Tremor” by the “Acidic Decay” stacks count.

When you kill an enemy or deal a Critical Hit on an enemy, you regain “Active Camouflage” state with a set chance. “Shock Nuts” is converted to “Frangible Rounds” that deal Damage by hitting enemies, inflicting “Electrocution” to the target.

Content Improvements

(1) Vulgus Largescale Outpost Improvements

(2) Missions

- Changed the objectives for field missions and infiltration operations, and improved monster placement.

Escort Missions
ㄴ Fixed the drone to move automatically even when you are not near them.
ㄴ The drone moves slower when you are not near them.
ㄴ Your Shield no longer drains when you are near the drone.
ㄴ You no longer have to defend the drone after completing the escort.
ㄴ Adjusted the escort travel distance for some missions to reduce the escort duration.

Defense Missions
ㄴ Defeating all monsters that spawn in a Defense Mission now completes the mission immediately.
ㄴ Same as Resource Defense Special Operations.

Multi-Assassination Missions
ㄴ The next wave of monsters now appear immediately when all monsters are defeated.
ㄴ Reduced the wait time caused by monster spawn animations.

Occupation Missions
ㄴ Reduced missions with 2 or more consecutive occupations to 1 occupation or replaced with Extermination.
ㄴ Reduced the time required for occupation and changed the mission time limit to 5 minutes.
ㄴ Increased the occupation range for some missions.

Miscellaneous
ㄴ Changed the locations where monsters spawn and spread out in all directions.
ㄴ Monsters that are difficult to deal with no longer spawn in multiple numbers simultaneously.
- Lowered the difficulty of missions in Invasion quests so that they don't block progression.
ㄴ Changed the location of gimmick platforms to make it easier to progress.
ㄴ Decreased the proportion of ranged monsters and increased the proportion of melee monsters to help players respond to them during gimmicks.
ㄴ Lowered monster levels and reduced the number of monsters.

 

(3) Customization

Paint Feature
- Added more paintable targets
ㄴ The default Descendant head and body skins can now be painted.
ㄴ The default weapon skins can now be painted.
ㄴ Chest and back attachments can also be painted.

- Individual paint application
ㄴ Painted skins equipped by Descendants can now be saved individually.
ㄴ The same common skin can be painted and saved in different colors for each Descendant that equips it.
ㄴ Descendants that have Regular and Ultimate versions can also have their painted skins saved separately.

Paint Sorting Improvement
- The paints that have been applied to skins are now displayed at the top of the Paint list.

 
(4) Matchmaking Improvements
- To improve the matching experience, the matchmaking logic has been changed as follows:
Reduced network latency range when matching
ㄴ When matchmaking is requested, users in nearby areas will be searched first, and the range will gradually expand.
ㄴ Previously, the maximum search range was set somewhat wide, but the latency search criteria has been strictly revised to ensure that the most neighboring regions are allocated for searching.

Added same-platform priority matching logic
ㄴ Added a logic that prioritizes same-platform matching for matchmaking requests.
ㄴ This prioritizes matching with the same platform during the matching wait time, and matching gradually expands to other platforms over time.

# Producer's Comment

We've analyzed the matchmaking data from last season and improved the logic as above.
First, we've narrowed the search range to prioritize matches with neighboring regions, which we hope will reduce the number of matches that experience server lag (network latency).
However, our simulation results showed that this could slightly increase the matching time, but we expect this will provide a smoother playing experience than before, so we've made this change.

And we were originally going to add the cross-play on/off option to the PC platform.
But simulations indicate that the resulting matching pool would be extremely fragmented, so we decided to improve the matching logic first rather than adding the option.
Simulations of the same-platform priority matching suggest that it will provide a better experience than the cross-play off option.
Therefore, we decided to put the option addition on hold for now and check the matching results before making any further changes.

The Dev Team will continue to monitor the results of the changed matchmaking logic in live and make further improvements and responses as needed.

notes.title: Season 2 Shop Changes and Discontinued Products
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants!

As we welcome the Season 2 updates, we inform you of changes that will be made in Shop, the end of the sale of Season 1 Battle Pass, and the discontinuation of some of our products. 

We listened to your opinions on improving skins and decorations and incorporated them into the game.
From Season 2, the sales and application of skins and decorations will be changed.

■ Changes Made to 'Limited Products'
(1) Changes to the Category and Sales of 'Limited Skins'
- From Season 2, the 'Limited Skins' category title will be changed to 'Recommended Skins.'
- You may purchase products under the 'Recommended Skins' category individually or in bundles. (All items included in discount bundles will be released permanently as individual items)
- Some products will be offered for certain periods. These products may be rereleased through events or promotions at a later time.

(2) Rerelease of Products Sold Under the 'Limited Skins' Category Before Season 2 Updates
- We are aware that many of Descendants want the re-offering of 'limited skins' that were previously on sale. However, under the relevant law, 'limited products' cannot be re-offered for sale.
- Please note that the items listed below will not be rereleased for sale in the future once they are discontinued.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/766e53b72d3b2dec495d18927ec5f895d4ddf53a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/076a6db0487092aae98df1d1d201410541bb98a8.png

■ Changes to the Application of Common Skins
(1) Shared Application of Common Skins
- After Season 2 updates, all common skins will become shareable. Purchasing a skin once will allow all of your Descendants who can equip the skin to use it.
- Future additional common skins may also have different applicable Descendants for each skin.
- The Descendants eligible to apply each common skin are as shown below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/39c0392f2f2d16bc773cb90bcf64b646efcd16c1.png

(2) Refund of Caliber and Paint spent for additional purchases of common skins
- With the shared application of common skins, Descendants who purchased the same common skin twice or more before the Season 2 updates, will be refunded for the Caliber you spent for the additional purchases.
- Paint applied to common skins will now be shared across all Descendants. Duplicate Paint used previously on the same common skin will also be refunded.
- Details of Caliber and Paint refunds will be provided in a separate announcement in December.

(3) Extended sales period of some common skins
- With the shared application of common skins starting with the Season 2 update, we are extending the sales period of common skins currently available until the end of Season 2 so that more Descendants can use diverse skins.
- Find below the types of common skins with an extended sales period
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/d603fbc64a2177aa4a692dec23e5dd18cb3de286.png

■ Changes to the Sales of 'Ultimate Descendant Bundle'
- Previously, the 'Ultimate Descendant Bundle' was not a limited product and is available for rerelease in the future. However, it will now be available at all times to prevent potential confusion among Descendants about purchasing bundle products.

The components of the Ultimate Descendant Bundle made available for individual purchases are as follows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/7ddeb820b6f8c360c7882b293cc4298af55f1b84.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/0d5bfea0b1933dd756b0f0d5a826bfdaa2fc6ce5.png

■ End of Sale of Season 1 Battle Pass and Discontinued Products
- With the Season 2 updates, the sale of Season 1 Battle Pass and some other products will end. 
- Please see the details below for your Season 1 Battle Pass Reward and future purchases of our products. 
(1) End of Sale Schedule for Season 1 Battle Pass and Discontinued Products
- Available until maintenance on December 4th, 2024 (Wed) PST

(2) Notes on the End of Season 1 Battle Pass

notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants. 


Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.7, patched maintenance-free.

■ Patch Date
- PST 2024.11.06 (Wed) 23:00

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements
(1) Content Improvements 
- Reduced the cooldown for Outpost content from 60 to 30 seconds.

# Director's Comments
With this patch note, we’d like to share the Dev Team's reasoning behind reducing the Outpost cooldown to 30 seconds, along with our future plans for further improvements.

Stage 1: Outpost 30 Sec Reduction
Based on feedback, we’ve reduced the Outpost cooldown to 30 seconds. Completely removing the delay could make Outpost farming disproportionately more efficient than Infiltration Operations, potentially leading to less dynamic Outpost farming. With this change, the Outpost cooldown is set to 30 seconds, allowing you to enjoy smooth gameplay while maintaining efficiency similar to that of Infiltration.

Stage 2: Infiltration - Fragment - Fusion Reactor Farming Route Added
We recognize that the main problem with Outpost is forcing inconvenient reward acquisition, and lengthy 1-minute cooldown leading to tedious gameplay. To address this, we plan to enable you to farm Amorphous Materials not only in Outposts but also during Infiltration Operations. This update will allow you to choose between the Outpost - Fragment - Fusion Reactor or Infiltration - Fragment - Fusion Reactor farming paths, enabling farming without relying on Sharen. We aim to implement this change early in Season 2, and we’ll provide details as soon as the schedule is finalized.

Stage 3: Outpost Rework
Plans to rework Outposts are still under discussion. Following the addition of the new farming route (Infiltration Operation - Fragment - Fusion Reactor), we want to keep our options open for a variety of improvements. 
Our goal is to completely overhaul the role and gameplay of Outposts, aiming to improve them so they become more engaging content with continuous battles.

We expect this change to lead to an increase in participation in Infiltration Operations. 
Additionally, to resolve the issue of long matchmaking times in Infiltration Operations, we have made plans to introduce a random matchmaking feature. 
With this feature, you will be able to earn rewards for completing the selected Infiltration Operation, while the dungeon itself will be randomly matched. The goal is to reduce matchmaking times and provide pleasant multiplayer experience. 
We are preparing to implement the random matchmaking system on Season 2 update. 
Besides improving the farming route for Amorphous Materials with the addition of the Infiltration Operation - Fragment - Fusion Reactor route, we're always aiming to make efficiency improvements to farming as well as make it more engaging.

(2) UI & UX
- We have made improvements so you can adjust Module Settings immediately after completing an Infiltration Operation or Void Intercept Battle until right before matchmaking begins.
- The hold time for buttons for pop-up messages displayed under specific conditions has been reduced.
ㄴ Party Invitation Notification
ㄴ Join Party Application Notification
ㄴ Void Intercept Battle Completion Results Window
ㄴ Mission Completion Results Window
- Improved the Reactor info tooltip layout so the info can be viewed easier.
- Improved the Mission Results Window, including Infiltration Operations, to not display while other UI, such as the Inventory, is open.

(3) Miscellaneous
- Removed the hero landing character animation when jumping from a high altitude. You can now transit to next action more quickly after landing.

Bug Fixes 
(1) Content
- Special Operation/Defend Albion Resource: Fixed an issue where Missions or Challenges related to the complete condition were not being counted correctly.
 ㄴ As mentioned in the Known Issues notice, to apologize for the inconvenience, 20 Supply Coins will be sent via mail to Descendants who log in between PST 2024.11.06 (Wed) 23:00 - 2024.11.10 (Sun) 22:59. 
ㄴ For detailed information, please refer to the Defend Albion Resource Compensation notice.
- Special Operation/Defend Albion Resource: Fixed an issue where Siege and Sniper monster spawn sounds were not playing.
- Special Operation/Task Squad Mission: Fixed an issue where Task Squad Missions were not being cleared. 
- Fortress/Defend Albion Resources: Fixed an issue where monsters would not attack in specific locations
- Invasion: The Asylum: Fixed an issue where you could not join allies. 
- Battle Pass Challenges: Fixed an issue where some challenges were not being counted when completing Infiltration Operation: Hard 400%. 

(2) Weapons & Modules
- Ultimate Module “Sweeping Squad”: The Ultimate Module "Sweeping Squad" for both General Rounds and Special Rounds has been updated. The ATK UP effect of the module when defeating an enemy has been adjusted so that instead of being reset, only the "Duration" of the effect will be reset.
- Ultimate Weapon “Albion Cavalry Gun: The name of the status effect applied by ricochet has been changed from “Precise Strike” to “Stun”.
- Ultimate Weapon “Albion Cavalry Gun”: Fixed an issue where the visual effect on ricochet were only displayed on 2 enemies.
- Ultimate Weapon “Albion Cavalry Gun”: Fixed an issue where the visual effect on ricochet was not clearly visible.
- Ultimate Weapon “Albion Cavalry Gun”: Fixed an issue where this weapon’s ricochet did not activate on environmental objects in Intercept Battles.
- Ultimate Weapon “The Final Masterpiece”: Fixed an issue where the electric shock caused by the “Pulsing Shock” effect did not activate on environmental objects in Intercept Battles.
- Ultimate Weapon “The Final Masterpiece”: Fixed an issue where the electric shock visual effects of the “Pulsing Shock” effect when firing the weapon was displayed on only one target.
- Ultimate Weapon “The Final Masterpiece”: Fixed an issue where the visual effects of “Puddle of Indulgence” triggered by the “Endless Indulgence” effect disappears faster than its duration.
- Ultimate Weapon “The Final Masterpiece”: Fixed an issue where enemies intermittently became immobilized while in the “Puddle of Indulgence” triggered by the “Endless Indulgence” effect.
- Ultimate Weapon “The Final Masterpiece” & “Perforator”: Fixed an issue where some effects obstructed too much of the view.
- Ultimate Weapon “Perforator”: Fixed an issue where the burst effect of “Explosive Scanner” appeared too bright in dark areas.
- Ultimate Weapons “Smithereens” & “Piercing Light” : Fixed an issue where the “Critical Hit Rate“was displayed as "Fixed."
- [PS]: Fixed an issue where the values in Weapon Stats were displayed incorrectly.

(3) UI & UX
- Research Status: The progress status of lower-level material research displayed in the Research list has been corrected to match the actual progress.
- “Ion Accelerator” Research: Fixed an issue where the research time was displayed incorrectly after cancelling the “Ion Accelerator” research.

(4) Shop

- Preview image: Fixed an issue where the preview image of the “Twisted Worship Set” in the shop was displayed incorrectly. 

Thank you.

PS5 Pro Enhanced Update

Graphic Mode Quality Improvements

Bug Fixes

(2) Descendants

Greetings, Descendants. This is Minseok Joo, Director of First Descendant.

We apologize for not having been able to fully engage with you as we focused on updates and hotfixes. Please look forward to the “Community Q&A” on October 31 for more information. Thank you for your interest, and we are always listening to your feedback.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants.

Here are the details on The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.5, patched maintenance-free on Thursday, October 17th.

■ Patch Date
- Thursday, October 17th, 2024 00:00 PDT

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements & Bug Fixes
(1) Infiltration Operation: Hard on 400%
- Improved an intermittent screen lag issue that occurs while playing Infiltration Operation: Hard on 400%.
- Fixed an issue where Champion Monster attribute and reward information were not updated upon selecting the 400% score multiplier in the Infiltration Operation: Hard entry UI.
- Fixed an issue where the right HUD information would display a fixed Max Score of 50,000 while playing Infiltration Operation: Hard on 400%.

(2) ETA-0
- Added a 'Select All' option that allows you to select all blueprints that you own more than one of when selling blueprints to ETA-0.
- Energy Activator blueprints and Crystallization Catalyst blueprints can no longer be sold to ETA-0.
- When selling blueprints to ETA-0, you can now only select blueprints up to the limit of rewards you can hold.
- ETA-0 now continues to display the name of items that have been sold out.

(3) Invasion
- Fixed an issue where the mission marker would display at the previous location on restart after dying in the final battle area of Echo Swamp - The Chapel where the Invasion is taking place.
- Fixed an issue where you could only join allies near the entrance of the final Commander Monster battle area of Vespers - The Shelter, Fortress: Quarantine Zone, and Echo Swamp - The Chapel where the Invasion is taking place.
- Fixed an issue where the UI did not display normally on the start screen when starting an Invasion mission.

(4) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where the 'Outgoing damage increase per bomb' of the Creative Explosion skill did not reflect correctly when using Esiemo's Creative Explosion skill module.

(5) UI/UX
- Added a button to the bottom of the Game Menu UI to check the event banner in-game.
- Selecting a Paint to dye a head skin or hair now highlights the Descendant's head.
- Fixed an issue in the 'Forgotten Comms Device' and 'Ancient Transmission Detection Facility' missions in White-night Gulch where designating a beacon as a waypoint displayed two markers.
- Fixed an issue where additional monsters summoned by a monster's skill during Extermination missions displayed the Extermination marker.
- Fixed an issue where some text in the Inventory list sorted by Reactor was not displaying correctly. 

(6) Miscellaneous
- Added 'Dismantle all tiers' option to the 'Exclude from junk' filter.
ㄴ Added 'Dismantle all tiers' option to the tier settings in Reactor and External Component tabs.
ㄴ Selecting 'Dismantle all tiers' designates all reactors and external components you own as Junk.
However, enhanced reactors and external components with set effects need to be designated separately.
- Cash shop bundles that include Descendant exclusive items now display the text "This product includes an exclusive item."
- Made some changes to the chat banned word system. 

# Director's Comments
Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.

Over the next week, the Dev Team will be conducting a final review process of the PS5 Pro build in order to deliver the "Pro Enhanced" features as a Day-1 patch in time for the launch of the PS5 Pro. 
With the "Pro Enhanced" feature, we aim to bring you enhanced performance and visuals that could not be experienced on the original PS5 from day one of the PS5 Pro launch. 
The final review of the PS5 Pro build is expected to last approximately one week, and there will not be any updates next week to ensure QA and build stability. 
The 1.1.6 update is scheduled to go live on Wednesday, October 30th. 

Today, I'll briefly comment on the upcoming 1.1.6 update scheduled for October 30th. 

First up is an update on the improvements to Special Operation - Resource Defense. 
We're changing the waves in Resource Defense to 10 stages, dramatically reducing playtime so that all waves can be completed in about 15 minutes and can be cleared even quicker as your Descendant grows stronger. 
Previously, players had to move to monster spawn areas to find them, but with these improvements, battles will be concentrated around defense objects. 
We've also increased the number of monster spawns per wave, allowing you to experience tense battles as you defend your resources against Vulgus onslaught.
In addition to this, we will provide Weapon Proficiency as an additional reward, while maintaining the existing reward system. The Dev Team's goal is to make Resource Defense the most efficient Weapon Proficiency farm.

Next, I would like to mention the addition of the 'Reactor Implant' system. 
The Dev Team has been working on the Reactor Implant system to eliminate the inconvenience of having to farm a new Reactor every time you switch to a new weapon. 
Now, one Ultimate Reactor can have up to three weapon Optimization Conditions. This allows you to change weapons during combat and still maintain your Optimization Conditions. 
Also, the second and third Optimization Conditions can be changed at any time, giving you the freedom to apply the Optimization Conditions you want whenever your weapon settings change.
The Dev Team is constantly reviewing feedback and data on the Reactor system and Reactor farming, and looking to bring you a more improved Reactor system in the long term, so please stay tuned.

We also have various QoL improvements and Ultimate Weapon revamp in the works.

And on Thursday, October 24th, we'll be rolling out the 'Primary Account Setup' feature on our official website. 
If you play The First Descendant on multiple platforms and have linked your Nexon account, this feature will allow you to set up and change the Primary Account on the official website and play the game with the set Primary Account.
We'll provide more details in another announcement on Thursday, October 24th.
Then on Wednesday, October 30th, the much-requested 'Rename Game Account' feature will become available, which will also be announced in a separate announcement.

The Dev Team is always listening to your feedback, and we're giving our all to make The First Descendant even more enjoyable to play. 
We sincerely appreciate your continued interest and valuable feedback, and we'll continue to make progress step by step to meet your expectations, so please look forward to it. 

Thank you.

Thank you.

Ultimate Freyna Skill Modules

As enemies gain more stacks of Necrosis, your Firearm ATK increases when you shoot at them, and if an enemy reaches max stacks, your Firearm Critical Hit Rate also increases.
- Venom Injection: Defense Mechanism is changed to Venom Injection. Venom Injection consumes resources to recover your Shield and increase Skill Power Modifier, while inflicting Corrosion on enemies. Hailey Skill Modules

Also, successful Weak Point attacks recover your Shield instead of your MP. The increase in Weak Point Damage decreases on firing the Unique Weapon, but increases again on successful Weak Point attacks.
- Cryogenic Cluster Shot: The Cryo effect is changed to Cryogenic. Using a firearm to attack an enemy inflicted with Cryogenic deals additional AoE damage to nearby enemies, making this a useful skill module for clearing out Common monsters.

- Improved the Research List to show the enhancement level information for Unique Abilities of Owned Weapons in Weapon Research.
- Improved the Research List to display the Owned indicator in lower level research as well in Descendant Research.
- Improved the Research List to show whether the Research results exist and how many.

(4) Miscellaneous
- Improved farming by adding Reactors to the Hard difficulty field, allowing you to farm them when needed.
ㄴ When obtaining Reactor (not as rotation reward) in Hard difficulty missions, outposts, or fusion reactors, you will acquire Reactor with specific attributes and Arche based on each battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/dc5c75f67ebb24393e2bda823cd66d9a507b3f5f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/c6bb877dbc787e2224fa0ae80758ddb05e433b4b.png
- 'Roly-poly' and 'Kingfisher' summoned by Colossi in Intercept Battles now use melee attacks less frequently.
- Lowered the difficulty of the Intercept Battle: Gluttony.
ㄴ Reduced Gluttony's HP and ATK.
ㄴ Impurity now reduces the wipe attack gauge further.
ㄴ Reduced the speed at which the wipe attack gauge fills up.
ㄴ Removed the Ice effect inflicted when the Impurity explodes. 
- Increased the expansion limit of Equipment Inventory and Storage Slots by 200.
ㄴ Previously expandable to 1,000, now expandable to 1,200.
- Changed the images for Valby's Bubble Boogie spray, Hailey's Sniper spray, map image of ‘Echo Swamp,’ the Descendant menu visuals for Valby/Ultimate Valby and some emotes’ icons have been updated.

Bug Fixes
(1) Content
- Fixed an issue where characters would get stuck or could move improperly in some world regions of Kingston, the Sterile Land, Hagios, and the Fortress.
- Fixed an issue in The Forgottense during the Sterile Land Invasion event where it was possible to move to the next zone before it started.
- It is no longer possible to leave the starting area using Mid-Air Maneuvering at the start of an Intercept Battle.
- Dying during an Encrypted Vault minigame now causes the minigame to fail.
- Fixed an issue where opening the map at the same time as an Encrypted Vault minigame starts left the game unresponsive.
- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to use the keyboard & mouse and gamepad at the same time. 
- Fixed an issue where Invasion awards in the Fortress region were not being tracked properly.

(2) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where skills used by pointing at a location could be used on 'out-of-bounds terrains.'
- Fixed an issue where the Water Intake and Supply Moisture effects could not be received in certain situations while standing on the Puddles created by Valby's skills.
- Fixed an issue where using Esiemo's Arche Explosion or Creative Explosion when there is a network lag caused the animations to display abnormally.
- Fixed an issue where, upon expiry of the detection time for Esiemo's Guided Landmine and the removal of the mine, the Blast skill button displayed the number of stacks remaining.
- Fixed an issue where the description of Haley's Zenith skill omitted a phrase stating that launchers are excluded.
- Fixed an issue where Hailey's Storm Snare skill did not deal damage when her character was not exposed due to terrain, etc.
- Fixed an issue where projectiles from Viessa's Frost Shards skill could not hit objects such as gas cylinders and Void Fusion Reactors through Burst.
- Fixed an issue where Luna's skill sounds would not play when you open the Select Descendant screen while Luna is equipped with her Unique Weapon and then exit the UI.
- When Luna is equipped with her default skill and the modules Noise Surge, Singer's Mercy, and Aggressive Melody, the animation of the skill button at the bottom now appears matching the notes.
- Fixed an issue where the animation effect of Freyna's Room 0 Trauma was displaying incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where the Plague Bodyarmor effect from Freyna's Defense Mechanism and Toxic Stimulation skills could both be granted.
ㄴ With this change, only the Plague Bodyarmor effect granted last will remain in effect for the duration.
ㄴ Affected skill modules: Contagion, Toxic Stimulation, Neurotoxin Synthesis

(3) Equipment & Modules
- Fixed an issue where the modules Decimator and Lethal Infection did not activate due to certain debuffs.
- Fixed an issue where the 'Additional damage increase' per enhancement level of the Last Stand module was not applied correctly.
- Fixed an issue where the 'Additional damage on attacks against enemies at full HP' effect of the Preemptive Strike module did not apply to targets with Shield.

(4) UI & UX
- Fixed an issue where the focusing effect does not display on the map when you click 'Go to' from the Acquistion Info of a specific item and the target is an 'Infiltration Operation: Hard' with an Invasion taking place.   
- Fixed an issue where the web browser window could not be closed when you click Check Out Recommended Modules.
- Fixed an issue where the category remained in the cash store even when there were no products available for purchase due to the end of sale.
- Fixed an issue where an abnormal message is displayed when you try to put an item into the Storage when it is full.
- Fixed an issue where certain titles displayed abnormal text.

(5) Miscellaneous 
- Fixed an issue where 'unstable energy (purple spheres)' did not cause a chain of explosions with each other in the Intercept Battle: Gluttony.
- Fixed an issue where obtaining a 'HP Orb' increased Max HP by 1.
- Fixed an issue where the animations of attachments did not play when the player equipping them used a group emote.
- Fixed an issue where titles were not displayed in the Player Interaction menu.
- Fixed an issue where the map marker descriptions for the quests 'Follow Their Traces,' 'The Traces Continue,' and In Search of the Relic' were not displayed during Bunny's Descendant quest.
- Fixed an issue with the awarding of Mastery Rank EXP.
ㄴ Fixed an issue where Mastery Rank EXP was being awarded based on the previous level when a weapon proficiency level increased. When progressing from Proficiency Level 1 to 2, Mastery Rank EXP corresponding to Level 1, not Level 2, was being awarded.
ㄴ Fixed an issue where you could not gain Mastery Rank EXP from level 1 to 10 when Bunny was obtained through quests.
ㄴ The unawarded Mastery Rank EXP will be given after the update. 
- Fixed an issue where the spawn effects were not displayed for battle supplies from the Battle Pass.
- Fixed an issue where the Battle Pass challenge 'Counterattack' was not counted correctly. 
- Fixed an issue where 1 Caliber was consumed when clicking "Confirm" with 0 seconds remaining on Accelerate Research.
ㄴ Caliber consumed due to this issue before the update will be reimbursed via in-game mail. Once the reimbursement is complete, we will provide details in the "October Known Issues Update" notice.

Thank you.

notes.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Descendants. 

We are here to give you the details about patches for The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.3, applied maintenance-free on Thursday, 9/26.

■ Patch Schedule
- 09.26.2024 (Thu) 00:00 PDT

■ Platforms
- Steam, Xbox Series X│S, Xbox One, PS4, PS5

■ Patch Details

Content Improvements
(1) Content
- You can now start Public Operations in the Invasion.
ㄴ The number of monsters increases depending on the number of participants.
ㄴ Order of Truth - Interacting with a drone now makes other drones despawn.
- Fortress - Fallen Ark Void Fragment has been changed.
ㄴ Expanded the terrain.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/b151fa675381902fe6b2a66efbb210114f1d6ccb.png
ㄴ Additional snipers has been placed for the second round.
- Traps in certain dungeons have been modified or deleted.
ㄴ Sterile Land - Unknown Laboratory (Hard)
ㄴ Agna Desert - Caligo Ossuary (Normal, Hard), The Asylum (Normal, Hard)
ㄴ White-night Gulch - Bio-Lab (Normal, Hard)
ㄴ Hagios - The Haven (Normal, Hard), Old Mystery (Normal, Hard)
- The amount of HP orbs and ammo dropped by scout monsters roaming the field, has increased.

(2) Descendants
- Yujin's 'Hyperreactive Healing Ground' skill now heals HP after granting Purification, rather than before.
- Improved certain skills of Freyna, Kyle, and Esiemo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/bfd5b02680a1f08c3015a494ecaffb16b3dfc469.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/f93e304f9da17b13b1134527b092a33710b76664.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/9e45ad2f5550f3a9c22a9a43c537bd038b8f81d7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/852042b01c3be95474cf5f449f3270ebf47c97fb.png

(3) Weapons/Modules
- Two new Modules have been added.
ㆍ Bio Sync Shield
ㄴ Reduces HP Recovery from HP orbs by a certain amount and instead heals the shield by the said amount.
ㆍ Last Stand
ㄴ When using a skill to attack enemies, consumes all of your shield to deal additional damage equivalent to a certain percentage of the total damage.
ㄴ The additional damage has a base value, and the value increases based on the amount of shield consumed.
ㄴ After activation, recovers Shield by a certain percentage of Max Shield every second for a certain period of time. It has a Cooldown.

(4) UI/UX
- Now you can check recommended stats for each Intercept Battle.
ㄴ Recommended stats include Weapon DPS, Max HP, Max Shield, DEF, and Resistance per Attribute.
- Ultimate Weapons will no longer be filtered as junk regardless of the 'Exclude from Junk' settings.
ㄴ In order to dismantle an Ultimate Weapons, you need to manually designate it as junk.
- Max Capacity UP Modules now display Capacity with the '+' sign in the Module UI.
- Tracked Items in the Research UI will no longer be untracked when the Research is completed.
- In No Resurrection Zones of Infiltration Operations, a system message will tell you that you cannot abandon rescue during the DBNO state.
- You can now set whether to run or sprint by default for movement in Game Options.
- The range of possible values for Controller - Dead Zone settings in Game Options has been increased from 20-40 to 0-99.
- You can now set Controller - Vibration Intensity to 'Weak' in Game Options.
- Terrain damage in every field now reduces Shield first. (The survival time is the same as before.)
- Customize – Spawn settings have been moved to the Descendant Skins menu.
- The Storage object under the Workbench in Albion has been moved to near the Mailbox above.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/4947c2e5fe3539db4614902b959c4303c3da71cf.png
(5) Optimization
- [PS5, XSX, XSS] Slightly improved the game's CPU performance.
- Frame Generation improvements and changes
ㄴ Fixed an issue where enabling AMD Frame Generation often caused frame drops.
ㄴ You can now enable AMD Frame Generation on PS4 Pro and XB1X.
ㄴ Removed a restriction where the option could only be enabled on a 120Hz display on consoles.
ㄴ You can now choose Frame Generation regardless of the upscale you're using on PC. (However, Nvidia Frame Generation can only be enabled on GeForce 40 Series or higher.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/d8a4532bb6abace50011f34633ae8d3f960b2064.png

(6) Miscellaneous
- Now you can view Spawn/Despawn animations for each Descendant in Customize.
- Added a feature to rewatch cinematics.
ㄴ You can use this feature by interacting with an Arche Trace in Albion, the camp of a battlefield where the cinematic took place, and the starting point of Infiltration Operations.
ㄴ Arche Traces can be found in the following locations:
Albion
Kingston - The Destruction
Sterile Land - The Forgottense
Vespers - The Shelter
Echo Swamp - The Chapel
Agna Desert - Miragestone
White-night Gulch - Mystery's End
Hagios - Old Mystery
Fortress - Heart of the Fortress
Fortress - Quarantine Zone
ㄴ The infiltration operation cinematic can be viewed again by starting the "Private Operation”.

# Director's Comments
Since Cinematics provide higher quality lighting compared to the usual gameplay environment, they're perfectly suited for players to examine their customization. Since players who finished the story cannot see the Ultimate Descendants they've farmed or their customized Descendants in cinematics, we've added a feature to rewatch them.

Now you can rewatch cinematics after finishing the story with the Hailey you've acquired or the Ultimate Descendant you've worked hard to get. Get a more vivid look at your own Descendant, customized with various skins and paints, in high-quality cinematics.
- Added the "Preview in Field" button in the Customize UI. Now you can preview the appearance and paint color with an actual field as the background.

(7) Shops
- You can buy the products listed below in the Shop.
ㄴ Ultimate Lepic Bundle I
ㄴ Premium Ultimate Lepic Bundle I
ㄴ Ultimate Viessa Bundle I
ㄴ Premium Ultimate Viessa Bundle I
ㄴ Ultimate Ajax Bundle I
ㄴ Premium Ultimate Ajax Bundle I
ㄴ Ultimate Bunny Bundle I
ㄴ Premium Ultimate Bunny Bundle I
ㄴ Ultimate Gley Bundle I
ㄴ Premium Ultimate Gley Bundle I
ㄴ Freyna's Vulgus Slayer
ㄴ Gley's Vampire
ㄴ Valby's Glowing Frog
ㄴ Emergency Oxygen Cylinder
- The 'Back Attachment' and 'Spawn' included in the 'Premium Ultimate Descendant Bundle I' are exclusive to the corresponding Ultimate Descendant and cannot be used by other Descendants.


Bug Fixes
(1) Content Improvements
- Fixed an issue where you cannot acquire a mission object when monsters die before exiting the dimensional gate.
(2) Descendants
- Fixed an issue where the field of view would be locked when changing weapons, while using Bunny's 'Speed of Light' skill. - Fixed an issue where certain effects of Ultimate Bunny would not be displayed on the Descendant List animation screen.
- Fixed an issue where using Hailey's 'Zenith' skill on an unstable network connection could cause an incorrect field of view when shooting while aiming after the end of the skill.
- Fixed an issue where Ajax's 'Body Enhancement' Skill Module could cause the 'Void Energy' UI to display the effect for only one segment.
- Fixed the incorrect icon images for Viessa's 'Cold Snap Watch' and 'Hypothermia' Module descriptions.
- Fixed the incorrect icon image for Luna's 'Aggressive Melody' Skill Module description.
- Fixed the incorrect icon image for Lepic and Ultimate Lepic's 'Power Unit Change' Skill Module description.
- Fixed an issue where 'Shield Recovery Modifier' did not affect certain Descendants' skills with a Shield Recovery effect.
ㄴ Enzo, Yujin, Ajax, and Kyle's Shield Recovery skills are now properly affected by the said stat.

(3) Weapons/Modules
- Executor's 'Executor's Exaltation' effect no longer activates when attacking enemies that are immune to the effect or hitting environment objects in Intercept Battles.
- Fixed an issue with the Wave of Light - where the effect of 'Solar Halo' remains when changing weapons.
- The effect of the 'Lethal Finish' Module is now properly applied per Cooldown when attacking an enemy with the 'Guardian Lance' of King's Guard Lance.

(4) UI/UX
- Fixed an issue with the acquisition info popup for tracked Core Materials in the Access Info UI, where the list would close when you placed the cursor over it.
- Fixed an issue with the acquisition info popup in the Access Info screen under the certain display resolution where tooltips for Amorphous Material would flicker.
- Fixed an issue in the Infiltration Operation UI, where hovering the cursor over the Research Materials in the reward list after hovering over the Amorphous Materials in the Selectable Rewards could cause the tooltip to display the 'Shape Stabilizer Application Info' and 'Amorphous Material Linked Reconstructed Device Info' buttons.

(5) Miscellaneous 
- Changed the barricade height in all Outposts to 2m or higher.
- Fixed an issue leaving the map in the air in the Fortress - Defense Line. 
- Fixed an issue where attacking a Colossus when they appear would not increase the Frenzy Gauge.

# Director's Additional Comment
Hello, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.

Today, we also prepared the 'Dev Note Vol. 14' along with the Hotfix changes to tell you about the upcoming October 10th update. Be sure to check out the preview of content that will arrive on October 10th.
[Dev Series] Dev Note Vol. 14 - Oct 10 Update Announcement

The 'Freyna's Encrypted Vault Shop' event has also begun. Accomplish missions, use the points you've collected to unlock Encrypted Vaults and get the rewards you want!
[Go to Event Page]


Thank you.

notes.notes:
The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.2b 

Greetings, Descendants.  
Here are the details regarding The First Descendant Hotfix 1.1.2b, applied on Friday, 9/13. 

■ Patch Date 
- 09.13.2024 (FRI) 00:00 PDT 

■ Platforms 
- Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, XBOX ONE, PS4, PS5 

■ Patch Details 
The following changes are temporarily applied from the 1.1.2b update until the 1.1.3 update: 
- Ultimate Weapons cannot be designated as Junk. 
- Ultimate Weapons that are already designated as Junk can have the Junk designation deselected. excluded.
